-- Cargo.toml --
[package]
name = "xcom"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.82"
description = "ATK-XCOM 风格串口调试助手 — 跨平台串口工具 (Rust + egui)"
authors = ["xcom contributors"]
license = "MIT"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/example/xcom"
keywords = ["serial", "serialport", "uart", "egui", "gui"]
categories = ["command-line-utilities", "gui"]

[[bin]]
name = "xcom"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
egui = "0.36"
eframe = { version = "0.36", default-features = false, features = [
    "default_fonts",
    "glow",
    "wayland",
    "x11",
] }
# eframe depends on winit with default features off, which silently drops
# `wayland-csd-adwaita`.  Without it winit falls back to a bare-bones
# client-side frame: square corners and right-hand window buttons that ignore
# the desktop's `button-layout` setting.  With it, sctk-adwaita draws a proper
# Adwaita frame and reads the system button layout (left on GNOME by default).
# The dependency is purely a feature switch; it is never referenced in code.
# Only affects Linux: winit gates it behind a non-macOS Unix cfg.
winit = { version = "0.30", default-features = false, features = ["wayland-csd-adwaita"] }
serialport = "4.10"
encoding_rs = "0.8"
chardetng = "1.0"
crossbeam-channel = "0.5"
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
rfd = "0.17"
chrono = "0.4"
fontdb = "0.24"
log = "0.4"
env_logger = "0.11"

[dev-dependencies]
# Used only by the Unix PTY loopback test, which needs `openpty`.
libc = "0.2"

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
strip = true

[profile.dev]
opt-level = 1

[profile.dev.package."*"]
opt-level = 2
-- README headings --
README.md:1:# XCOM Serial Debug Assistant
README.md:5:A cross-platform serial port debugging tool written in **Rust + egui**, reimplementing the features and UI of the ALIENTEK **ATK-XCOM v3.0**, running on **Windows / Linux / macOS**.
README.md:31:## Feature Comparison
README.md:37:| Auto-scan available serial ports, show detailed port info | ✅ | Background thread enumeration; shows VID:PID / vendor / product / serial number; hot-plug support |
README.md:42:| Hot-plug serial ports | ✅ | Auto-closes and prompts on disconnect |
README.md:69:### Additions in This Implementation
README.md:76:- **Adjustable receive area font size and line spacing**; auto-wrap width follows window resize.
README.md:77:- Configuration file persistence; restores last serial and display settings after restart.
README.md:81:## Installation and Running
README.md:83:### Prerequisites
README.md:94:# Debian / Ubuntu
README.md:97:# Fedora
README.md:102:### Build and Run
README.md:110:### UI Language
README.md:115:- The implementation uses a gettext-style approach: **the Chinese text is the translation key**, wrapped as `tr("打开串口")`. This makes batch conversion mechanical and diffs readable; if a translation is missing, it falls back to the Chinese original rather than showing a blank label.
README.md:119:### Window Frame and Rounded Corners
README.md:128:### Platform Notes
README.md:132:| **Linux** | Add your user to the `dialout` group for sudo-free serial port access: `sudo usermod -aG dialout $USER` (re-login required). File dialogs use XDG Desktop Portal; if the system lacks a portal, the path selection before "Save Raw Data" may not respond — use the config file or run in a supported environment. |
README.md:134:| **macOS** | On first launch, allow the app in "System Settings → Privacy & Security"; serial devices look like `/dev/tty.usbserial-*`. |
README.md:136:### CJK Fonts
README.md:138:The UI is in Chinese; on startup the program automatically searches for CJK fonts on the system, in this order:
README.md:140:1. Common font paths (e.g., `/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc`, `C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc`, `/System/Library/Fonts/PingFang.ttc`);
README.md:141:2. Via `fontdb` scanning system fonts, matching Noto Sans CJK / Source Han Sans / Microsoft YaHei / PingFang / WenQuanYi, etc.
README.md:143:If none are found, the program still runs but Chinese characters appear as squares, with a status bar prompt to install a font (on Linux, install `fonts-noto-cjk` or `fonts-wqy-microhei`).
README.md:147:## Adaptive Encoding
README.md:149:Text encoding from serial devices is highly inconsistent: 8051/STM32 firmware typically uses **GBK**, ESP-IDF outputs **UTF-8**, and Japanese modules often use **Shift_JIS**. The original tool requires manual selection — pick wrong and you get garbled text.
README.md:166:## Protocol Transfer
README.md:192:### A Practical Constraint
README.md:198:## Keyboard Shortcuts
README.md:203:| `Ctrl + O` | Open / close serial port |
README.md:210:## Desktop Integration (Linux)
README.md:259:## Configuration File
README.md:273:## Known Limitations
README.md:275:1. **1.5 stop bits**: Windows DCB supports `ONE5STOPBITS`, but the Rust `serialport` crate doesn't expose it; on Linux/macOS, termios can only express 1.5 stop bits with `CSTOPB + CS5` when **data bits = 5**. Therefore this option **explicitly prompts "treated as 2 stop bits"** on unsupported combinations, rather than silently opening with wrong parameters.
README.md:282:## Development
README.md:303:- **Real serial send/receive**: opening a port with PTY, driving timed send and asserting the peer receives repeated payloads, and that send echo indeed enters the receive area without polluting the receive stream;
README.md:306:### Code Structure
README.md:310:  main.rs          Entry point, font installation
README.md:311:  app.rs           App state, serial/timer event pump, shortcuts
README.md:318:  fonts.rs         CJK font discovery
README.md:319:  serial/          Serial config, port enumeration (hot-plug), link and read/write threads

/// Headless layout tests.
///
/// The panel code is the largest surface in the program and the easiest place
/// for a panic to hide, because it only runs on a real frame.  `run_ui` gives
/// us the same root `Ui` that eframe hands to `App::ui`, so a full frame can be
/// laid out and tessellated without a window or a GPU.
#[cfg(test)]
mod layout_tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::logstore::{HexStyle, ViewMode};
    use crate::theme::ThemeMode;

    /// A frame input with a monotonically increasing time.
    ///
    /// Every frame in these tests must take its time from here: egui panics if
    /// time ever goes backwards, and a frame with no time advances its clock by
    /// `predicted_dt`, which would overtake a fixed value.
    fn input() -> egui::RawInput {
        egui::RawInput {
            screen_rect: Some(egui::Rect::from_min_size(
                egui::Pos2::ZERO,
                egui::vec2(1280.0, 840.0),
            )),
            time: Some(next_time()),
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    /// Lay out two frames and assert the result is not empty.
    ///
    /// Two passes matter: the first populates panel state (scroll areas, grid
    /// widths) and the second re-reads it, which is where sizing bugs show up.
    fn render(app: &mut XcomApp, ctx: &egui::Context, what: &str) {
        for pass in 0..2 {
            let mut output = ctx.run_ui(input(), |ui| app.draw(ui));
            let shapes = output.shapes.len();
            // A real renderer applies these; the test only cares that the frame
            // laid out, so discard them explicitly rather than leaking.
            output.textures_delta.clear();
            assert!(shapes > 0, "{what}: pass {pass} produced no shapes");
        }
    }

    fn seeded() -> XcomApp {
        let mut app = XcomApp::headless(crate::settings::Settings::default());
        app.log
            .append("AT+GMR\r\nOK\r\n温度: 25.6C\r\n".as_bytes(), 0);
        app.rx_bytes = 31;
        app.tx_bytes = 8;
        app.settings.send.buffer = "AT".to_owned();
        app.settings.send.history = vec!["AT".to_owned(), "AT+RST".to_owned()];
        app.settings.serial.port = "/dev/ttyUSB0".to_owned();
        app
    }

    /// A frame with an optional pointer press at `pos`.
    fn pointer(pos: egui::Pos2, pressed: Option<bool>) -> egui::RawInput {
        let mut raw = input();
        raw.events.push(egui::Event::PointerMoved(pos));
        if let Some(pressed) = pressed {
            raw.events.push(egui::Event::PointerButton {
                pos,
                button: egui::PointerButton::Primary,
                pressed,
                modifiers: Default::default(),
            });
        }
        raw
    }

    /// Lay out every real panel for one frame, returning the centre column.
    fn full_frame(ctx: &egui::Context, app: &mut XcomApp, raw: egui::RawInput) -> egui::Rect {
        let slot = std::cell::Cell::new(egui::Rect::NOTHING);
        let mut output = ctx.run_ui(raw, |ui| {
            panels::top_bar(app, ui);
            panels::status_bar(app, ui);
            panels::left_panel(app, ui);
            if app.show_side_panel {
                panels::side_panel(app, ui);
            }
            slot.set(ui.available_rect_before_wrap());
            panels::center_panel(app, ui);
            // Mirrors `draw`: the splitters are registered after every panel.
            panels::apply_splitters(app, ui);
        });
        output.textures_delta.clear();
        slot.get()
    }

    /// Press at `from`, drag to `to`, release.  Every frame lays out the real
    /// panels, which is required: a panel that is not laid out never registers
    /// its resize handle, so there would be nothing to grab.
    /// A monotonically increasing frame time.
    ///
    /// egui panics if time goes backwards, so every drag in a test must
    /// continue from where the previous one stopped rather than restarting.
    fn next_time() -> f64 {
        thread_local! {
            static TIME: std::cell::Cell<f64> = const { std::cell::Cell::new(1000.0) };
        }
        TIME.with(|t| {
            let next = t.get() + 0.02;
            t.set(next);
            next
        })
    }

    fn drag(ctx: &egui::Context, app: &mut XcomApp, from: egui::Pos2, to: egui::Pos2) {
        let positions = [from, from, to, to, to];
        let presses = [None, Some(true), None, None, Some(false)];
        for (position, pressed) in positions.into_iter().zip(presses) {
            full_frame(ctx, app, pointer(position, pressed));
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn dragging_the_settings_separator_widens_the_panel() {
        let ctx = egui::Context::default();
        let mut app = XcomApp::headless(crate::settings::Settings::default());
        app.show_side_panel = false;

        let before_rect = full_frame(&ctx, &mut app, input());
        let before_content = panels::probe::left_content_width();
        assert!(
            before_content > 0.0,
            "the settings content was not laid out"
        );

        let grab = egui::pos2(before_rect.min.x, before_rect.center().y);
        drag(&ctx, &mut app, grab, egui::pos2(grab.x + 80.0, grab.y));

        let after_rect = full_frame(&ctx, &mut app, input());
        assert!(
            after_rect.min.x > before_rect.min.x + 40.0,
            "the panel did not widen: {} -> {}",
            before_rect.min.x,
            after_rect.min.x
        );
        assert!(
            panels::probe::left_content_width() > before_content,
            "the content did not follow the panel"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn dragging_the_send_separator_grows_the_editor() {
        let ctx = egui::Context::default();
        let mut app = XcomApp::headless(crate::settings::Settings::default());

        full_frame(&ctx, &mut app, input());
        let before = panels::probe::editor_rect();
        let panel = panels::probe::send_panel_rect();
        assert!(before.height() > 0.0, "the editor was not laid out");
        assert!(panel.height() > 0.0, "the send panel was not laid out");

        let grab = egui::pos2(panel.center().x, panel.top());
        drag(&ctx, &mut app, grab, egui::pos2(grab.x, grab.y - 90.0));

        let after = panels::probe::editor_rect();
        assert!(
            after.height() > before.height() + 40.0,
            "the editor did not follow the separator: {} -> {}",
            before.height(),
            after.height()
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn shrinking_the_settings_panel_persists() {
        // Reported: dragging the left separator *left* clipped the panel's
        // content during the gesture and then snapped back on release, while
        // the receive area never grew.
        let ctx = egui::Context::default();
        let mut app = XcomApp::headless(crate::settings::Settings::default());
        app.show_side_panel = false;

        let before = full_frame(&ctx, &mut app, input());
        let grab = egui::pos2(before.min.x, before.center().y);
        drag(&ctx, &mut app, grab, egui::pos2(grab.x - 40.0, grab.y));

        let after = full_frame(&ctx, &mut app, input());

            "the panel snapped back instead of staying shrunk: {} -> {}",
            before.min.x,
            after.min.x
        );

        // And it must still be shrunk several frames later, i.e. the size was
        // committed rather than merely applied for one frame.

            full_frame(&ctx, &mut app, input());

  1166	///
  1167	/// `fixed` is the total width of the checkbox, index and button columns, which
  1168	/// do not scale; everything left over is shared 62/38 between 内容 and 备注.
  1169	fn multi_column_widths(available: f32, spacing: f32) -> (f32, f32) {
  1170	    let fixed = 30.0 + 24.0 + 30.0 + 32.0 + 58.0 + 52.0;
  1171	    // No per-column floor: a floor larger than the leftover space would push
  1172	    // the table past the panel edge, which is the very problem this solves.
  1173	    // The two columns always sum to the leftover, so the table fits exactly.
  1174	    let flexible = (available - spacing * 6.0 - fixed).max(0.0);
  1175	    (flexible * 0.62, flexible * 0.38)
  1176	}
  1177	
  1178	fn multi_panel(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
  1179	    // ---- paging -----------------------------------------------------------
  1180	    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
  1181	        if ui.button(tr("首页")).clicked() {
  1182	            app.settings.multi.first_page();
  1183	        }
  1184	        if ui.button(tr("上一页")).clicked() {
  1185	            app.settings.multi.previous_page();
  1186	        }
  1187	        ui.label(crate::i18n::tr2(
  1188	            "第 {} / {} 页",
  1189	            app.settings.multi.page + 1,
  1190	            crate::multi::PAGES,
  1191	        ));
  1192	        if ui.button(tr("下一页")).clicked() {
  1193	            app.settings.multi.next_page();
  1194	        }
  1195	        if ui.button(tr("尾页")).clicked() {
  1196	            app.settings.multi.last_page();
  1197	        }
  1198	    });
  1199	
  1200	    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
  1201	        if ui.button(tr("导入条目")).clicked() {
  1202	            if let Some(path) = pick_open_file(tr("导入发送条目")) {
  1203	                match std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {
  1204	                    Ok(text) => {
  1205	                        let multi = &mut app.settings.multi;
  1206	                        match multi.import_json(&text) {
  1207	                            Ok(count) => {
  1208	                                app.mark_settings_dirty();
  1209	                                app.ok(crate::i18n::tr1("已导入 {} 个条目", count));
  1210	                            }
  1211	                            Err(err) => app.error(err),
  1212	                        }
  1213	                    }
  1214	                    Err(err) => app.error(crate::i18n::tr1("读取文件失败: {}", err)),
  1215	                }
  1216	            }
  1217	        }
  1218	        if ui.button(tr("导出条目")).clicked() {
  1219	            if let Some(path) = pick_save_file(tr("导出发送条目"), "xcom-entries.json", "json")
  1220	            {
  1221	                let multi = &app.settings.multi;
  1222	                match multi.export_json() {
  1223	                    Ok(text) => match std::fs::write(&path, text) {
  1224	                        Ok(()) => app.ok(crate::i18n::tr1("已导出到 {}", path.display())),
  1225	                        Err(err) => app.error(crate::i18n::tr1("写入失败: {}", err)),
  1226	                    },
  1227	                    Err(err) => app.error(err),
  1228	                }
  1229	            }
  1230	        }
  1231	        let can_send = app.link.is_open() && !app.multi_run_active();
  1232	        if ui
  1233	            .add_enabled(can_send, egui::Button::new(tr("发送已勾选")))
  1234	            .on_hover_text(tr("按顺序发送本页所有已勾选且非空的条目"))
  1235	            .clicked()
  1236	        {
  1237	            app.start_multi_run(app.settings.multi.page, false, std::time::Instant::now());
  1238	        }
  1239	
  1240	        let mut loop_enabled = app.settings.multi.loop_enabled;
  1241	        let can_loop = app.link.is_open();
  1242	        if ui
  1243	            .add_enabled(
  1244	                can_loop,
  1245	                egui::Checkbox::new(&mut loop_enabled, tr("循环发送")),
  1246	            )
  1247	            .changed()
  1248	        {
  1249	            app.settings.multi.loop_enabled = loop_enabled;
  1250	            let page = app.settings.multi.page;
  1251	            if loop_enabled {
  1252	                app.start_multi_run(page, true, std::time::Instant::now());
  1253	            } else {
  1254	                app.stop_multi_run(tr("已停止循环发送"));
  1255	            }
  1256	            app.mark_settings_dirty();
  1257	        }
  1258	        if app.settings.multi.loop_enabled {
  1259	            let mut period = app.settings.multi.loop_period_ms;
  1260	            if ui
  1261	                .add(
  1262	                    egui::DragValue::new(&mut period)
  1263	                        .speed(10.0)
  1264	                        .range(1..=3_600_000)
  1265	                        .suffix(" ms"),
  1266	                )
  1267	                .changed()
  1268	            {
  1269	                app.settings.multi.loop_period_ms = period;
  1270	                app.mark_settings_dirty();
  1271	            }
  1272	        }
  1273	    });
  1274	
  1275	    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
  1276	        ui.label(tr("轮次间隔"));
  1277	        let mut forever = app.settings.multi.loop_count.is_none();
  1278	        if ui.checkbox(&mut forever, tr("无限循环")).changed() {
  1279	            app.settings.multi.loop_count = if forever { None } else { Some(10) };
  1280	            app.multi_cycles = 0;
  1281	            app.mark_settings_dirty();
  1282	        }
  1283	        match app.settings.multi.loop_count {
  1284	            None => {
  1285	                ui.label(
  1286	                    RichText::new(tr("不限次数"))
  1287	                        .small()
  1288	                        .color(ui.visuals().weak_text_color()),
  1289	                );
  1290	            }
  1291	            Some(limit) => {
  1292	                let mut value = limit;
  1293	                if ui
  1294	                    .add(
  1295	                        egui::DragValue::new(&mut value)
  1296	                            .speed(1.0)
  1297	                            .range(1..=1_000_000),
  1298	                    )
  1299	                    .changed()
  1300	                {
  1301	                    app.settings.multi.loop_count = Some(value);
  1302	                    app.multi_cycles = 0;
  1303	                    app.mark_settings_dirty();
  1304	                }
  1305	                ui.label(
  1306	                    RichText::new(crate::i18n::tr2(
  1307	                        "已完成 {} / {} 次",
  1308	                        app.multi_cycles,
  1309	                        limit,
  1310	                    ))
  1311	                    .small()
  1312	                    .color(ui.visuals().weak_text_color()),
  1313	                );
  1314	            }
  1315	        }
  1316	    });
  1317	
  1318	    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
  1319	        let mut keypad = app.settings.multi.keypad_enabled;
  1320	        if ui
  1321	            .checkbox(&mut keypad, tr("关联数字键盘 (1-9,0)"))
  1322	            .changed()
  1323	        {
  1324	            app.settings.multi.keypad_enabled = keypad;
  1325	            app.mark_settings_dirty();
  1326	        }
  1327	        let mut cr = app.settings.multi.newline_cr;
  1328	        let mut lf = app.settings.multi.newline_lf;
  1329	        let a = ui.checkbox(&mut cr, tr("新行 CR")).changed();
  1330	        let b = ui.checkbox(&mut lf, tr("新行 LF")).changed();
  1331	        if a || b {
  1332	            app.settings.multi.newline_cr = cr;
  1333	            app.settings.multi.newline_lf = lf;
  1334	            app.mark_settings_dirty();
  1335	        }
  1336	    });
  1337	
  1338	    ui.separator();
  1339	
  1340	    // ---- entries ----------------------------------------------------------
  1341	    let page = app.settings.multi.page;
  1342	    let mut send_request: Option<usize> = None;
  1343	    let mut dirty = false;
  1344	
  1345	    // egui's `Grid` reuses the previous frame's column widths as a *floor*
  1346	    // (`child_size.max(prev_width)`), so a table built with it can grow but
  1347	    // never shrink -- dragging the splitter back left the columns too wide and
  1348	    // pushed the send button off the edge.  Laying the rows out by hand with
  1349	    // explicit widths is what makes them track the panel in both directions.
  1350	    //
  1351	    // These five widths must sum to the `fixed` constant in
  1352	    // `multi_column_widths`, or the row will not fill the panel exactly.
  1353	    let enable_w = 30.0;
  1354	    let index_w = 24.0;
  1355	    let hex_w = 30.0;
  1356	    let newline_w = 32.0;
  1357	    // Delay applied after this entry, before the next one.
  1358	    let delay_w = 58.0;
  1359	    let send_w = 52.0;
  1360	
  1361	    const ROW_H: f32 = 20.0;
  1362	    const GAP: f32 = 5.0;
  1363	
  1364	    let (text_width, note_width) = multi_column_widths(ui.available_width(), GAP);
  1365	
  1366	    // Fill the panel with rows rather than fixing each page at ten entries.
  1367	    let rows_that_fit = ((ui.available_height() - ROW_H * 1.5) / (ROW_H + 4.0)).floor();
  1368	    let visible = rows_that_fit.max(crate::multi::ENTRIES_PER_PAGE as f32) as usize;
  1369	    if app.settings.multi.ensure_len(page, visible) {
  1370	        app.mark_settings_dirty();
  1371	        dirty = true;
  1372	    }
  1373	    let total_rows = app
  1374	        .settings
  1375	        .multi
  1376	        .pages
  1377	        .get(page)
  1378	        .map_or(0, Vec::len)
  1379	        .max(visible);
  1380	
  1381	    egui::ScrollArea::both()
  1382	        .auto_shrink([false, false])
  1383	        .show(ui, |ui| {
  1384	            ui.spacing_mut().item_spacing = egui::vec2(GAP, 4.0);
  1385	
  1386	            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
  1387	                for (width, header) in [
  1388	                    (enable_w, tr("启用")),
  1389	                    (index_w, "#"),
  1390	                    (text_width, tr("内容")),
  1391	                    (note_width, tr("备注")),
  1392	                    (hex_w, "HEX"),
  1393	                    (newline_w, tr("新行")),
  1394	                    (delay_w, tr("延迟")),
  1395	                    (send_w, ""),

     1	//! XCOM 串口调试助手 — a cross-platform serial port assistant.
     2	//!
     3	//! A Rust + egui reimplementation of the ALIENTEK ATK-XCOM tool, with no
     4	//! advertising and with an adaptive character-encoding detector.
     5	
     6	// Do not open a console window alongside the GUI on Windows release builds.
     7	#![cfg_attr(not(debug_assertions), windows_subsystem = "windows")]
     8	
     9	mod app;
    10	mod encoding;
    11	mod fonts;
    12	mod hex;
    13	mod i18n;
    14	mod logstore;
    15	mod multi;
    16	mod protocol;
    17	mod serial;
    18	mod settings;
    19	mod theme;
    20	mod ui;
    21	
    22	fn main() -> eframe::Result<()> {
    23	    env_logger::Builder::from_env(env_logger::Env::default().default_filter_or("info")).init();
    24	    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
    25	
    26	    // The window title is set before the app is constructed, so the language
    27	    // has to be resolved here rather than in `XcomApp::new`.
    28	    let settings = settings::Settings::load();
    29	    i18n::set_lang(settings.lang.unwrap_or_else(i18n::system_lang));
    30	    log::info!(
    31	        "界面语言 {:?}，窗口标题: {}",
    32	        i18n::lang(),
    33	        i18n::window_title()
    34	    );
    35	
    36	    // Alpha is what makes the rounded corners possible: the pixels we never
    37	    // paint stay see-through.  Only needed where we supply the frame ourselves.
    38	    let transparent = ui::window::PAINTS_OWN_BACKGROUND;
    39	
    40	    let native_options = eframe::NativeOptions {
    41	        viewport: eframe::egui::ViewportBuilder::default()
    42	            .with_inner_size([1200.0, 780.0])
    43	            .with_min_inner_size([880.0, 540.0])
    44	            .with_transparent(transparent)
    45	            // A stable app id lets the compositor associate the window with its
    46	            // desktop entry (and therefore its icon).
    47	            .with_app_id("xcom")
    48	            .with_title(i18n::window_title()),
    49	        ..Default::default()
    50	    };
    51	
    52	    eframe::run_native(
    53	        &i18n::window_title(),
    54	        native_options,
    55	        Box::new(|cc| {
    56	            // Fonts must be installed before the first frame is laid out.
    57	            match fonts::install(&cc.egui_ctx) {
    58	                fonts::FontStatus::Loaded(family) => log::info!("已加载中文字体: {family}"),
    59	                fonts::FontStatus::Missing => {
    60	                    log::warn!("未找到中文字体，界面中文可能显示为方块")
    61	                }
    62	            }
    63	            let app = app::XcomApp::new(cc);
    64	            log::info!("启动完成用时 {:?}", started.elapsed());
    65	            Ok(Box::new(app))
    66	        }),
    67	    )
    68	}

    18	/// Severity of a status message.
    19	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
    20	pub(crate) enum Level {
    21	    Info,
    22	    Success,
    23	    Warning,
    24	    Error,
    25	}
    26	
    27	/// A transient status message shown in the status bar.

    42	
    43	/// A chunked background file transmission.
    44	pub(crate) struct FileSend {
    45	    pub path: String,
    46	    pub data: Vec<u8>,
    47	    pub offset: usize,
    48	    /// Bytes per tick, smoothed to avoid starving the UI.
    49	    pub chunk: usize,
    50	    pub last: Instant,
    51	}
    52	
    53	impl FileSend {
    54	    /// Bytes still to send.
    55	    pub fn remaining(&self) -> usize {
    56	        self.data.len().saturating_sub(self.offset)
    57	    }
    58	
    59	    /// Completion in `0.0..=1.0`.
    60	    pub fn progress(&self) -> f32 {
    61	        if self.data.is_empty() {
    62	            1.0
    63	        } else {
    64	            self.offset as f32 / self.data.len() as f32
    65	        }
    66	    }
    67	}
    68	
    69	/// A line in the protocol transfer log.
    70	pub(crate) struct ProtocolLogLine {

    72	    pub text: String,
    73	    pub stamp: String,
    74	}
    75	
    76	/// A multi-send sequence in progress.
    77	///
    78	/// Entries are sent one at a time with each entry's own delay applied after it,
    79	/// and a completed round waits `round_gap_ms` before the next one.  Pacing the
    80	/// sequence rather than firing everything at once is what makes per-entry
    81	/// delays and the round gap possible.
    82	pub(crate) struct MultiRun {
    83	    page: usize,
    84	    queue: Vec<usize>,
    85	    position: usize,
    86	    /// When the next entry may go out.
    87	    next_at: Instant,
    88	    /// Whether to start another round after this one.
    89	    looping: bool,
    90	    /// Delay between rounds, from the settings.
    91	    round_gap: Duration,
    92	}

   162	impl XcomApp {
   163	    /// Build the application, loading persisted settings.
   164	    pub fn new(cc: &eframe::CreationContext<'_>) -> Self {
   165	        let settings = Settings::load();
   166	
   167	        // Restore the window size before the first frame.
   168	        if let Some([w, h]) = settings.window_size {
   169	            cc.egui_ctx
   170	                .send_viewport_cmd(eframe::egui::ViewportCommand::InnerSize(
   171	                    eframe::egui::vec2(w.max(640.0), h.max(420.0)),
   172	                ));
   173	        }
   174	
   175	        // Resolve the language before the first frame and remember the choice,
   176	        // so a system-locale guess sticks once the user has seen it.
   177	        let lang = settings.lang.unwrap_or_else(crate::i18n::system_lang);
   178	        crate::i18n::set_lang(lang);
   179	
   180	        let mut app = Self::headless(settings);
   181	        if app.settings.lang.is_none() {
   182	            app.settings.lang = Some(lang);
   183	            app.mark_settings_dirty();
   184	        }
   185	
   186	        // Apply the persisted theme now so the first frame is already correct.
   187	        crate::theme::apply(&cc.egui_ctx, app.settings.theme);
   188	        app.applied_theme = Some(app.settings.theme);
   189	
   190	        app
   191	    }
   192	
   193	    /// Build the application from explicit settings, with no egui context.
   194	    ///
   195	    /// Kept separate from [`new`](Self::new) so the UI can be laid out in a
   196	    /// headless test without an eframe `CreationContext`.
   197	    pub(crate) fn headless(settings: Settings) -> Self {
   198	        let mut app = Self {
   199	            log: LogStore::new(encoding_rs::UTF_8),
   200	            auto: AutoDetector::new(),
   201	            log_view: LogViewState::default(),
   202	            link: SerialLink::new(),
   203	            ports: PortWatcher::spawn(Duration::from_millis(1000)),
   204	            settings,
   205	            rx_bytes: 0,
   206	            tx_bytes: 0,
   207	            open_port_enumerated: false,
   208	            pending_rx: Vec::new(),
   209	            show_paused: false,
   210	            messages: Vec::new(),
   211	            last_timed_send: None,
   212	            multi_run: None,
   213	            multi_cycles: 0,
   214	            file_send: None,
   215	            protocol: ProtocolEngine::new(crate::protocol::ProtocolConfig::default(), 115200),
   216	            protocol_log: Vec::new(),
   217	            protocol_progress: None,
   218	            side_tab: SideTab::Multi,
   219	            show_side_panel: true,
   220	            show_about: false,
   221	            signals: Signals::default(),
   222	            signals_at: Instant::now(),
   223	            applied_theme: None,
   224	            applied_lang: None,
   225	            settings_dirty: false,
   226	            last_save: Instant::now(),
   227	            font_warning_shown: false,
   228	            pending_wrap_cols: None,
   229	            pending_splitters: Vec::new(),
   230	        };
   231	
   232	        app.protocol = ProtocolEngine::new(app.settings.protocol.clone(), app.settings.serial.baud);
   233	        app.log
   234	            .set_limits(app.settings.max_rows, app.settings.max_raw);
   235	        app.log.set_options(app.settings.display);
   236	        app.log.set_encoding(app.effective_encoding());
   237	        app.select_default_port();
   238	
   239	        app
   240	    }

   242	    // -- lifecycle ----------------------------------------------------------
   243

fn send_area(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
    probe::set_send_panel_rect(ui.max_rect());

    // Toolbar row height: tall enough that text/checkboxes are not clipped.
    const BTN_HEIGHT: f32 = 28.0;
    // Right margin between the 发送 button and the panel edge.
    const RIGHT_PAD: f32 = 6.0;

    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.set_height(BTN_HEIGHT);
        ui.spacing_mut().item_spacing = egui::vec2(6.0, 0.0);

        // ── Left: label + configuration controls ────────────────────────────
        ui.label(RichText::new(tr("发送区")).strong());
        ui.separator();

        let mut hex = app.settings.send.hex;
        if ui.checkbox(&mut hex, tr("16进制发送")).changed() {
            app.settings.send.hex = hex;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        let mut newline = app.settings.send.append_newline;
        if ui.checkbox(&mut newline, tr("发送新行")).changed() {
            app.settings.send.append_newline = newline;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        if app.settings.send.append_newline {
            let mut cr = app.settings.send.newline_cr;
            let mut lf = app.settings.send.newline_lf;
            let a = ui.checkbox(&mut cr, "CR").changed();
            let b = ui.checkbox(&mut lf, "LF").changed();
            if a || b {
                app.settings.send.newline_cr = cr;
                app.settings.send.newline_lf = lf;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }
        }

        let mut timed = app.settings.send.timed;
        let can_timed = app.link.is_open();
        if ui
            .add_enabled(can_timed, egui::Checkbox::new(&mut timed, tr("定时发送")))
            .changed()
        {
            app.settings.send.timed = timed;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        if app.settings.send.timed {
            let mut period = app.settings.send.period_ms;
            if ui
                .add(
                    egui::DragValue::new(&mut period)
                        .speed(10.0)
                        .range(1..=3_600_000)
                        .suffix(" ms"),
                )
                .changed()
            {
                app.settings.send.period_ms = period;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }
        }

        // ── Right: action buttons, right-to-left, with right padding ────────
        // Reserve RIGHT_PAD on the right edge before placing the 发送 button.
        let avail_w = (ui.available_width() - RIGHT_PAD).max(0.0);
        ui.allocate_ui_with_layout(
            egui::vec2(avail_w, BTN_HEIGHT),
            egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center),
            |ui| {
                ui.spacing_mut().item_spacing = egui::vec2(6.0, 0.0);

                // Rightmost: 发送 (drawn first in right_to_left)
                let send_btn = ui.add_sized(
                    [96.0, BTN_HEIGHT],
                    egui::Button::new(RichText::new(tr("发送 (Ctrl+Enter)")).strong()),
                );
                if send_btn.clicked() {
                    app.send_once();
                }

                // 发送文件 / 终止发送
                if app.file_send.is_some() {
                    if ui
                        .add_sized([76.0, BTN_HEIGHT], egui::Button::new(tr("终止发送")))
                        .clicked()
                    {
                        app.abort_file_send();
                    }
                } else if ui
                    .add_sized([76.0, BTN_HEIGHT], egui::Button::new(tr("发送文件")))
                    .clicked()
                {
                    if let Some(path) = pick_open_file(tr("选择要发送的文件")) {
                        app.start_file_send(path);
                    }
                }

                // 清除发送
                if ui
                    .add_sized([76.0, BTN_HEIGHT], egui::Button::new(tr("清除发送")))
                    .clicked()
                {
                    app.settings.send.buffer.clear();
                    app.tx_bytes = 0;
                    app.rx_bytes = 0;
                    app.mark_settings_dirty();
                    app.info(tr("已清除发送区与收发计数"));
                }

                // 历史 (leftmost of the button group)
                egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("send_history")
                    .selected_text(tr("历史"))
                    .width(68.0)
                    .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                        if app.settings.send.history.is_empty() {
                            ui.weak(tr("暂无历史"));
                        }
                        let history = app.settings.send.history.clone();
                        for entry in history {
                            let preview: String = entry.chars().take(40).collect();
                            if ui.selectable_label(false, preview).clicked() {
                                app.settings.send.buffer = entry;
                                app.mark_settings_dirty();
                            }
                        }
                    });
            },
        );
    });

    if let Some(send) = app.file_send.as_ref() {
        let progress = send.progress();
        let remaining = send.remaining();
        let name = send.path.clone();
        ui.add(
            egui::ProgressBar::new(progress)
                .text(crate::i18n::tr2("{} · 剩余 {} 字节", name, remaining))
                .desired_height(16.0),
        );
    }

    // Fill whatever height the user has dragged the send area to.  A fixed
    // `desired_rows` left the editor four rows tall no matter how the panel
    // was resized, which reads as "dragging does nothing".
    let available = ui.available_size();
    let editor_size = egui::vec2(available.x, available.y.max(48.0));
    let editor = ui.add(
        egui::TextEdit::multiline(&mut app.settings.send.buffer)
            .font(egui::TextStyle::Monospace)
            .desired_width(editor_size.x)
            .min_size(editor_size)
            .hint_text(if app.settings.send.hex {
                tr("输入十六进制，如 01 02 0A（可省略空格）")
            } else {
                tr("输入要发送的内容")
            }),
    );
    probe::set_editor_rect(editor.rect);
}

-- multi section --
                {
                    app.side_tab = SideTab::Protocol;
                }
            });
            ui.separator();
            match app.side_tab {
                SideTab::Multi => multi_panel(app, ui),
                SideTab::Protocol => protocol_panel(app, ui),
            }
        });

    let outer = panel.response.rect;
    app.pending_splitters.push(PendingSplitter {
        id: "tool_panel",
        growth: SplitterGrowth::Leftward,
        boundary: outer.left(),
        cross: outer.y_range(),
        current_size: app.settings.right_panel_width,
        min: RIGHT_PANEL_MIN,
        max: RIGHT_PANEL_MAX,
        target: SplitterTarget::RightWidth,
    });
}

/// Split the space available to the multi-send table between its two text
/// columns.
///
/// `fixed` is the total width of the checkbox, index and button columns, which
/// do not scale; everything left over is shared 62/38 between 内容 and 备注.
fn multi_column_widths(available: f32, spacing: f32) -> (f32, f32) {
    let fixed = 30.0 + 24.0 + 30.0 + 32.0 + 58.0 + 52.0;
    // No per-column floor: a floor larger than the leftover space would push
    // the table past the panel edge, which is the very problem this solves.
    // The two columns always sum to the leftover, so the table fits exactly.
    let flexible = (available - spacing * 6.0 - fixed).max(0.0);
    (flexible * 0.62, flexible * 0.38)
}

fn multi_panel(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
    // ---- paging -----------------------------------------------------------
    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
        if ui.button(tr("首页")).clicked() {
            app.settings.multi.first_page();
        }
        if ui.button(tr("上一页")).clicked() {
            app.settings.multi.previous_page();
        }
        ui.label(crate::i18n::tr2(
            "第 {} / {} 页",
            app.settings.multi.page + 1,
            crate::multi::PAGES,
        ));
        if ui.button(tr("下一页")).clicked() {
            app.settings.multi.next_page();
        }
        if ui.button(tr("尾页")).clicked() {
            app.settings.multi.last_page();
        }
    });

    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
        if ui.button(tr("导入条目")).clicked() {
            if let Some(path) = pick_open_file(tr("导入发送条目")) {
                match std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {
                    Ok(text) => {
                        let multi = &mut app.settings.multi;
                        match multi.import_json(&text) {
                            Ok(count) => {
                                app.mark_settings_dirty();
                                app.ok(crate::i18n::tr1("已导入 {} 个条目", count));
                            }
                            Err(err) => app.error(err),
                        }
                    }
                    Err(err) => app.error(crate::i18n::tr1("读取文件失败: {}", err)),
                }
            }
        }
        if ui.button(tr("导出条目")).clicked() {
            if let Some(path) = pick_save_file(tr("导出发送条目"), "xcom-entries.json", "json")
            {
                let multi = &app.settings.multi;
                match multi.export_json() {
                    Ok(text) => match std::fs::write(&path, text) {
                        Ok(()) => app.ok(crate::i18n::tr1("已导出到 {}", path.display())),
                        Err(err) => app.error(crate::i18n::tr1("写入失败: {}", err)),
                    },
                    Err(err) => app.error(err),
                }
            }
        }
        let can_send = app.link.is_open() && !app.multi_run_active();
        if ui
            .add_enabled(can_send, egui::Button::new(tr("发送已勾选")))
            .on_hover_text(tr("按顺序发送本页所有已勾选且非空的条目"))
            .clicked()
        {
            app.start_multi_run(app.settings.multi.page, false, std::time::Instant::now());
        }

        let mut loop_enabled = app.settings.multi.loop_enabled;
        let can_loop = app.link.is_open();
        if ui
            .add_enabled(
                can_loop,
                egui::Checkbox::new(&mut loop_enabled, tr("循环发送")),
            )
            .changed()
        {
            app.settings.multi.loop_enabled = loop_enabled;
            let page = app.settings.multi.page;
            if loop_enabled {
                app.start_multi_run(page, true, std::time::Instant::now());
            } else {
                app.stop_multi_run(tr("已停止循环发送"));
            }
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        if app.settings.multi.loop_enabled {
            let mut period = app.settings.multi.loop_period_ms;
            if ui
                .add(
                    egui::DragValue::new(&mut period)
                        .speed(10.0)
                        .range(1..=3_600_000)
                        .suffix(" ms"),
                )
                .changed()
            {
                app.settings.multi.loop_period_ms = period;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }
        }
    });

    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
        ui.label(tr("轮次间隔"));
        let mut forever = app.settings.multi.loop_count.is_none();
        if ui.checkbox(&mut forever, tr("无限循环")).changed() {
            app.settings.multi.loop_count = if forever { None } else { Some(10) };
            app.multi_cycles = 0;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        match app.settings.multi.loop_count {
            None => {
                ui.label(
                    RichText::new(tr("不限次数"))
                        .small()
                        .color(ui.visuals().weak_text_color()),
                );
            }
            Some(limit) => {
                let mut value = limit;
                if ui
                    .add(
                        egui::DragValue::new(&mut value)
                            .speed(1.0)
                            .range(1..=1_000_000),
                    )
                    .changed()
                {
                    app.settings.multi.loop_count = Some(value);
                    app.multi_cycles = 0;
                    app.mark_settings_dirty();
                }
                ui.label(
                    RichText::new(crate::i18n::tr2(
                        "已完成 {} / {} 次",
                        app.multi_cycles,
                        limit,
                    ))
                    .small()
                    .color(ui.visuals().weak_text_color()),
                );
            }
        }
    });

    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
        let mut keypad = app.settings.multi.keypad_enabled;
        if ui
            .checkbox(&mut keypad, tr("关联数字键盘 (1-9,0)"))
            .changed()
        {
            app.settings.multi.keypad_enabled = keypad;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        let mut cr = app.settings.multi.newline_cr;
        let mut lf = app.settings.multi.newline_lf;
        let a = ui.checkbox(&mut cr, tr("新行 CR")).changed();
        let b = ui.checkbox(&mut lf, tr("新行 LF")).changed();
        if a || b {
            app.settings.multi.newline_cr = cr;
            app.settings.multi.newline_lf = lf;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
    });

    ui.separator();

    // ---- entries ----------------------------------------------------------
    let page = app.settings.multi.page;
    let mut send_request: Option<usize> = None;
    let mut dirty = false;

    // egui's `Grid` reuses the previous frame's column widths as a *floor*
    // (`child_size.max(prev_width)`), so a table built with it can grow but
    // never shrink -- dragging the splitter back left the columns too wide and
    // pushed the send button off the edge.  Laying the rows out by hand with
    // explicit widths is what makes them track the panel in both directions.
    //
    // These five widths must sum to the `fixed` constant in
    // `multi_column_widths`, or the row will not fill the panel exactly.
    let enable_w = 30.0;
    let index_w = 24.0;
    let hex_w = 30.0;
    let newline_w = 32.0;
    // Delay applied after this entry, before the next one.
    let delay_w = 58.0;
    let send_w = 52.0;

    const ROW_H: f32 = 20.0;
    const GAP: f32 = 5.0;

    let (text_width, note_width) = multi_column_widths(ui.available_width(), GAP);

    // Fill the panel with rows rather than fixing each page at ten entries.
    let rows_that_fit = ((ui.available_height() - ROW_H * 1.5) / (ROW_H + 4.0)).floor();
    let visible = rows_that_fit.max(crate::multi::ENTRIES_PER_PAGE as f32) as usize;
    if app.settings.multi.ensure_len(page, visible) {
        app.mark_settings_dirty();
        dirty = true;
    }
    let total_rows = app
        .settings
        .multi
        .pages
        .get(page)
        .map_or(0, Vec::len)
        .max(visible);

    egui::ScrollArea::both()
        .auto_shrink([false, false])
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            ui.spacing_mut().item_spacing = egui::vec2(GAP, 4.0);

            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                for (width, header) in [
                    (enable_w, tr("启用")),
                    (index_w, "#"),
                    (text_width, tr("内容")),
                    (note_width, tr("备注")),
                    (hex_w, "HEX"),
                    (newline_w, tr("新行")),
                    (delay_w, tr("延迟")),
                    (send_w, ""),
                ] {
                    ui.add_sized(
                        [width, ROW_H],
                        egui::Label::new(RichText::new(header).strong()),
                    );
                }
            });

            for index in 0..total_rows {
                let Some(entry) = app.settings.multi.entry_mut(page, index) else {
                    continue;
                };
                let stripe = index % 2 == 1;
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    if stripe {
                        let row = egui::Rect::from_min_size(
                            ui.cursor().min,
                            egui::vec2(ui.available_width(), ROW_H),
                        );
                        ui.painter().rect_filled(
                            row,
                            egui::CornerRadius::ZERO,
                            ui.visuals().faint_bg_color,
                        );
                    }
                    let mut row_changed = false;
                    row_changed |= ui
                        .add_sized(
                            [enable_w, ROW_H],
                            egui::Checkbox::new(&mut entry.enabled, ""),
                        )
                        .changed();
                    ui.add_sized([index_w, ROW_H], egui::Label::new(format!("{index}")));
                    row_changed |= ui
                        .add_sized(
                            [text_width, ROW_H],
                            egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut entry.text).hint_text(if entry.hex {
                                "01 02 0A"
                            } else {
                                tr("指令")
                            }),
                        )
                        .changed();
                    row_changed |= ui
                        .add_sized(
                            [note_width, ROW_H],
                            egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut entry.note).hint_text(tr("备注")),
                        )
                        .changed();
                    row_changed |= ui
                        .add_sized([hex_w, ROW_H], egui::Checkbox::new(&mut entry.hex, ""))
                        .changed();
                    row_changed |= ui
                        .add_sized(
                            [newline_w, ROW_H],
                            egui::Checkbox::new(&mut entry.newline, ""),
                        )
                        .changed();
                    let mut delay = entry.delay_ms;
                    if ui
                        .add_sized(
                            [delay_w, ROW_H],
                            egui::DragValue::new(&mut delay)
                                .speed(5.0)
                                .range(0..=3_600_000)
                                .suffix(" ms"),
                        )
                        .changed()
                    {
                        entry.delay_ms = delay;
                        dirty = true;
                    }
                    if ui
                        .add_sized([send_w, ROW_H], egui::Button::new(tr("发送")))
                        .clicked()
                    {
                        send_request = Some(index);
                    }
                    if row_changed {
                        dirty = true;

-- lifecycle/font draw --
        }
        let current_ok = available
            .iter()
            .any(|p| p.name == self.settings.serial.port);
        if !current_ok {
            // Prefer a USB adapter over a legacy built-in UART.
            let pick = available
                .iter()
                .find(|p| p.is_usb())
                .or_else(|| available.first())
                .map(|p| p.name.clone());
            if let Some(name) = pick {
                self.settings.serial.port = name;
            }
        }
    }

    /// Report font status once, after the first frame.
    fn note_font_status(&mut self) {
        if self.font_warning_shown {
            return;
        }
        self.font_warning_shown = true;
        if let Some(ui_family) = crate::fonts::installed_ui_family() {
            log::info!("Zed UI 字体: {ui_family}");
        }
        match crate::fonts::installed_family() {
            Some(family) => log::info!("中文字体: {family}"),
            None => self.warn(tr(
                "未找到中文字体，界面中文可能显示为方块。请安装 Noto Sans CJK / 文泉驿等字体",
            )),
        }
    }

    // -- messages -----------------------------------------------------------

    pub(crate) fn message(&mut self, level: Level, text: impl Into<String>) {
        let text = text.into();
        log::log!(
            match level {
                Level::Error => log::Level::Error,
                Level::Warning => log::Level::Warn,
                _ => log::Level::Info,
            },
            "{text}"
        );
        // Collapse an immediate repeat rather than flooding the list.
        if let Some(last) = self.messages.last_mut() {
            if last.text == text {
                last.at = Instant::now();
                return;
            }
        }
        self.messages.push(Message {
            level,
            text,
            at: Instant::now(),
        });
        if self.messages.len() > 50 {
            self.messages.remove(0);
        }
            self.toggle_port();
        }
    }
}

impl eframe::App for XcomApp {
    fn ui(&mut self, ui: &mut egui::Ui, _frame: &mut eframe::Frame) {
        self.draw(ui);
    }

    fn clear_color(&self, visuals: &egui::Visuals) -> [f32; 4] {
        crate::ui::window::clear_color(crate::theme::panel_background(visuals.dark_mode))
    }

    fn on_exit(&mut self, _gl: Option<&eframe::glow::Context>) {
        self.settings.window_size = None;
        if let Err(err) = self.settings.save() {
            log::error!("退出时保存设置失败: {err}");
        }
    }
}

impl XcomApp {
    /// Draw one complete frame.
    ///
    /// eframe 0.36 roots the app at a `Ui` rather than a `Context`, so the
    /// context is taken from it and used for the top-level panels.  Split out
    /// of the `App` impl so the headless test can lay out a real frame.
    pub(crate) fn draw(&mut self, ui: &mut egui::Ui) {
        let ctx = ui.ctx().clone();
        let ctx = &ctx;

        // The window backdrop goes down first, so every panel paints on top of
        // it.  Panels are transparent on platforms where we own the frame (see
        // `ui::window`), otherwise they would square off the bottom corners.
        crate::ui::window::paint_background(
            ui,
            crate::theme::panel_background(crate::theme::is_dark(ctx, self.settings.theme)),
        );

        // Styling only needs to be re-applied when the theme changes.
        let theme = self.settings.theme;
        if self.applied_theme != Some(theme) {
            crate::theme::apply(ctx, theme);
            self.applied_theme = Some(theme);
        }
        // The title bar is not re-read from the app, so switching language has
        // to push a new one; otherwise a Chinese UI keeps an English title
        // until the next launch.
        let language = crate::i18n::lang();
        if self.applied_lang != Some(language) {
            self.applied_lang = Some(language);
            ctx.send_viewport_cmd(egui::ViewportCommand::Title(crate::i18n::window_title()));
        }

        // egui's default grab band is 5 px, which is easy to miss and presents
        // as "the separator cannot be dragged at all".
        ui.style_mut().interaction.resize_grab_radius_side = 8.0;

        self.note_font_status();

        self.pump_serial(ctx);
        self.pump_timers(ctx);
        self.handle_shortcuts(ctx);

        panels::top_bar(self, ui);
        panels::status_bar(self, ui);
        panels::left_panel(self, ui);
        if self.show_side_panel {
            panels::side_panel(self, ui);
        }
        panels::center_panel(self, ui);
        panels::apply_splitters(self, ui);
        panels::about_window(self, ctx);

        self.maybe_save_settings(ctx);
    }
}

/// Draw the receive log.  Kept here so the panel code can call it without
/// depending on the log view module's internals.
pub(crate) fn draw_log(
    app: &mut XcomApp,
    ui: &mut egui::Ui,
    palette: crate::theme::LogPalette,
) -> log_view::LogViewOutput {
    let options = LogViewOptions {
        auto_scroll: app.settings.auto_scroll,
        font_size: app.settings.log_font_size,
        line_spacing: app.settings.line_spacing,
    };

    // Tell the store how many columns fit, so text wrapping matches the panel.
    let font = egui::FontId::monospace(app.settings.log_font_size);
    let char_width = ui.ctx().fonts_mut(|f| f.glyph_width(&font, 'M'));
    if char_width > 0.0 && app.settings.display.wrap {
        let cols = (ui.available_width() / char_width).floor().max(8.0) as usize;
        app.update_wrap_width(cols, ui.ctx());
    }
    // `show` needs &LogStore and &mut LogViewState from the same struct.
    let XcomApp { log, log_view, .. } = app;
    log_view::show(ui, log, palette, log_view, &options)
}

//! XCOM 串口调试助手 — a cross-platform serial port assistant.
//!
//! A Rust + egui reimplementation of the ALIENTEK ATK-XCOM tool, with no
//! advertising and with an adaptive character-encoding detector.

// Do not open a console window alongside the GUI on Windows release builds.
#![cfg_attr(not(debug_assertions), windows_subsystem = "windows")]

mod app;
mod encoding;
mod fonts;
mod hex;
mod i18n;
mod logstore;
mod multi;
mod protocol;
mod serial;
mod settings;
mod theme;
mod ui;

fn main() -> eframe::Result<()> {
    env_logger::Builder::from_env(env_logger::Env::default().default_filter_or("info")).init();
    let started = std::time::Instant::now();

    // The window title is set before the app is constructed, so the language
    // has to be resolved here rather than in `XcomApp::new`.
    let settings = settings::Settings::load();
    i18n::set_lang(settings.lang.unwrap_or_else(i18n::system_lang));
    log::info!(
        "界面语言 {:?}，窗口标题: {}",
        i18n::lang(),
        i18n::window_title()
    );

    // Alpha is what makes the rounded corners possible: the pixels we never
    // paint stay see-through.  Only needed where we supply the frame ourselves.
    let transparent = ui::window::PAINTS_OWN_BACKGROUND;

    let native_options = eframe::NativeOptions {
        viewport: eframe::egui::ViewportBuilder::default()
            .with_inner_size([1200.0, 780.0])
            .with_min_inner_size([880.0, 540.0])
            .with_transparent(transparent)
            // A stable app id lets the compositor associate the window with its
            // desktop entry (and therefore its icon).
            .with_app_id("xcom")
            .with_title(i18n::window_title()),
        ..Default::default()
    };

    eframe::run_native(
        &i18n::window_title(),
        native_options,
        Box::new(|cc| {
            // Fonts must be installed before the first frame is laid out.
            match fonts::install(&cc.egui_ctx) {
                fonts::FontStatus::Loaded(family) => log::info!("已加载中文字体: {family}"),
                fonts::FontStatus::Missing => {
                    log::warn!("未找到中文字体，界面中文可能显示为方块")
                }
            }
            let app = app::XcomApp::new(cc);
            log::info!("启动完成用时 {:?}", started.elapsed());
            Ok(Box::new(app))
        }),
    )
}

    /// Remember a payload, de-duplicating and bounding the list.
    pub fn remember(&mut self, payload: &str) {
        if payload.trim().is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        self.history.retain(|h| h != payload);
        self.history.insert(0, payload.to_owned());
        self.history.truncate(Self::MAX_HISTORY);
    }
}

/// The complete persisted state.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(default)]
pub struct Settings {
    pub theme: ThemeMode,
    /// Interface language; `None` means "not chosen yet, follow the system".
    pub lang: Option<Lang>,
    pub log_colors: LogColorOverride,
    pub serial: SerialConfig,
    pub display: DisplayOptions,
    /// Receive decoding: `None` means auto-detect.
    pub encoding: EncodingChoice,
    /// Transmit encoding: `None` means "follow the receive encoding".
    pub tx_encoding: EncodingChoice,
    pub send: SendSettings,
    pub multi: MultiSend,
    pub protocol: ProtocolConfig,
    /// The protocol panel's data field, restored on startup.
    pub protocol_data: String,
    /// Keep the receive view pinned to the newest line.
    pub auto_scroll: bool,
    /// Mirror transmitted data into the receive view.
    pub echo_sent: bool,
    /// Pause the display without dropping bytes.
    pub paused: bool,
    /// Extra spacing between log rows, in points.
    pub line_spacing: f32,
    pub log_font_size: f32,
    /// Maximum retained display rows.
    pub max_rows: usize,
    /// Maximum retained raw bytes.
    pub max_raw: usize,
    /// Width of the serial-settings panel, in points.  Owned by the app rather
    /// than by egui's panel state: see `ui::panels::splitter`.
    pub left_panel_width: f32,
    /// Width of the multi-send / protocol panel.
    pub right_panel_width: f32,
    /// Height of the send area below the log.
    pub send_area_height: f32,
    /// Window size, restored on startup.
    pub window_size: Option<[f32; 2]>,
}

impl Default for Settings {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            theme: ThemeMode::Dark,
            lang: None,
            log_colors: LogColorOverride::default(),
            serial: SerialConfig::default(),
            display: DisplayOptions::default(),
            encoding: None,
            tx_encoding: None,
            send: SendSettings::default(),
            multi: MultiSend::default(),
            protocol: ProtocolConfig::default(),
            protocol_data: String::new(),
            auto_scroll: true,
            echo_sent: true,
            paused: false,
            line_spacing: 0.0,
            log_font_size: 13.0,
            max_rows: 200_000,
            max_raw: 32 * 1024 * 1024,
            left_panel_width: crate::ui::panels::LEFT_PANEL_DEFAULT,
            right_panel_width: crate::ui::panels::RIGHT_PANEL_DEFAULT,
            send_area_height: crate::ui::panels::SEND_AREA_DEFAULT,
            window_size: None,
        }
    }
}

impl Settings {
    /// Clamp anything that could be nonsensical after a hand-edit.
    pub fn normalize(&mut self) {
        self.send.period_ms = self.send.period_ms.clamp(1, 3_600_000);
        self.log_font_size = self.log_font_size.clamp(8.0, 32.0);
        self.line_spacing = self.line_spacing.clamp(0.0, 12.0);
        self.max_rows = self.max_rows.clamp(1_000, 5_000_000);
        self.max_raw = self.max_raw.clamp(64 * 1024, 512 * 1024 * 1024);
        self.multi.normalize();
        self.protocol.normalize();
        self.left_panel_width = self.left_panel_width.clamp(
            crate::ui::panels::LEFT_PANEL_MIN,
            crate::ui::panels::LEFT_PANEL_MAX,
        );
        self.right_panel_width = self.right_panel_width.clamp(
            crate::ui::panels::RIGHT_PANEL_MIN,
            crate::ui::panels::RIGHT_PANEL_MAX,
        );
        self.send_area_height = self.send_area_height.clamp(
            crate::ui::panels::SEND_AREA_MIN,
            crate::ui::panels::SEND_AREA_MAX,
        );
    }

  1164	/// Split the space available to the multi-send table between its two text
  1165	/// columns.
  1166	///
  1167	/// `fixed` is the total width of the checkbox, index and button columns, which
  1168	/// do not scale; everything left over is shared 62/38 between 内容 and 备注.
  1169	fn multi_column_widths(available: f32, spacing: f32) -> (f32, f32) {
  1170	    let fixed = 30.0 + 24.0 + 30.0 + 32.0 + 58.0 + 52.0;
  1171	    // No per-column floor: a floor larger than the leftover space would push
  1172	    // the table past the panel edge, which is the very problem this solves.
  1173	    // The two columns always sum to the leftover, so the table fits exactly.
  1174	    let flexible = (available - spacing * 6.0 - fixed).max(0.0);
  1175	    (flexible * 0.62, flexible * 0.38)
  1176	}

//! CJK font discovery.
//!
//! The entire UI is in Chinese, so a font with CJK coverage is mandatory.  The
//! default egui fonts cover Latin only, and bundling a full CJK face would add
//! ~10 MB to every binary.  Instead we locate a system font at startup: first
//! from a list of well-known paths (fast, and covers almost every real desktop)
//! and then by asking `fontdb` for any installed family with a CJK name.
//!
//! If nothing is found the app still runs; Chinese text simply renders as
//! tofu, and the UI says so in the log so the cause is obvious.

use std::sync::Arc;

use eframe::egui;

/// Family names that indicate CJK coverage, in descending preference.
///
/// Ordering matters: a sans-serif with broad coverage is a better UI font than
/// a serif or a handwriting face.
const PREFERRED_FAMILIES: &[&str] = &[
    "Noto Sans CJK SC",
    "Noto Sans SC",
    "Source Han Sans SC",
    "Sarasa Gothic SC",
    "Sarasa Mono SC",
    "Microsoft YaHei UI",
    "Microsoft YaHei",
    "PingFang SC",
    "Hiragino Sans GB",
    "Heiti SC",
    "WenQuanYi Micro Hei",
    "WenQuanYi Zen Hei",
    "Noto Sans CJK TC",
    "Noto Sans CJK JP",
    "SimHei",
    "SimSun",
    "Arial Unicode MS",
];

/// Well-known font file paths, tried before the slower database scan.

const KNOWN_PATHS: &[&str] = &[
    "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc",
    "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansSC-Regular.otf",

];

#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]

/// A loaded font face, ready to hand to egui.
pub struct LoadedFont {
    /// Family name, for display in the UI.
    pub family: String,
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
    /// Face index within a font collection (`.ttc`).
    pub index: u32,
}

/// Well-known UI font paths (Zed / IBM Plex / clean sans).
