    #[test]
    fn mixed_script_text_keeps_one_baseline() {
        let ctx = egui::Context::default();
        crate::fonts::install(&ctx);
        let text = "启用#内容备注HEX新行延迟";
        let galley = ctx.fonts_mut(|fonts| {
            fonts.layout_no_wrap(
                text,
                egui::FontId::proportional(14.0),
                egui::Color32::WHITE,
            )
        });

        let baselines: Vec<(char, f32)> = galley
            .rows
            .iter()
            .flat_map(|row| row.glyphs.iter())
            .map(|glyph| (glyph.chr, glyph.pos.y))
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(baselines.len(), text.chars().count());
        let min = baselines.iter().map(|(_, y)| *y).fold(f32::INFINITY, f32::min);
        let max = baselines
            .iter()
            .map(|(_, y)| *y)
            .fold(f32::NEG_INFINITY, f32::max);
        assert!(
            max - min <= 0.01,
            "ASCII/CJK glyphs use different baselines: {min:.3}..={max:.3} ({baselines:?})"
        );
    }

fn combo<T: PartialEq + Copy>(
    ui: &mut Ui,
    id: &str,
    current: &mut T,
    options: &[T],
    label: impl Fn(T) -> String,
) -> bool {
    let mut changed = false;
    egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt(id)
        .selected_text(label(*current))
        .width(140.0)
        .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
            for option in options {
                if ui
                    .selectable_value(current, *option, label(*option))
                    .clicked()
                {
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
        });
    changed
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Top bar
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

pub(crate) fn top_bar(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
    egui::Panel::top("top_bar").show(ui, |ui| {
        ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
            ui.label(tr("主题"));
            let mut theme_mode = app.settings.theme;
            if combo(ui, "theme_mode", &mut theme_mode, &ThemeMode::ALL, |m| {
                format!("{} {}", m.icon(), tr(m.label()))
            }) {
                app.settings.theme = theme_mode;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }

            ui.separator();
            ui.label(tr("语言"));
            let mut language = i18n::lang();
            egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("language")
                .selected_text(language.label())
                .width(110.0)
                .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                    for candidate in Lang::ALL {
                        if ui
                            .selectable_value(&mut language, candidate, candidate.label())
                            .clicked()
                        {
                            i18n::set_lang(candidate);
                            app.settings.lang = Some(candidate);
                            app.mark_settings_dirty();
                        }
                    }
                });

            ui.separator();
            ui.checkbox(&mut app.show_side_panel, tr("显示工具面板"));

            ui.separator();
            let mut log_colors = app.settings.log_colors;
            if ui
                .checkbox(&mut log_colors.enabled, tr("自定义接收区配色"))
                .changed()
            {
                app.settings.log_colors = log_colors;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }
            if app.settings.log_colors.enabled {
                ui.label(tr("字色"));
                let mut fg = app.settings.log_colors.foreground;
                if ui.color_edit_button_srgb(&mut fg).changed() {
                    app.settings.log_colors.foreground = fg;
                    app.mark_settings_dirty();
                }
                ui.label(tr("底色"));
                let mut bg = app.settings.log_colors.background;
                if ui.color_edit_button_srgb(&mut bg).changed() {
                    app.settings.log_colors.background = bg;
                    app.mark_settings_dirty();
                }
            }

            ui.separator();
            ui.label(tr("接收区字号"));
            let mut size = app.settings.log_font_size;
            if ui
                .add(egui::Slider::new(&mut size, 8.0..=28.0).fixed_decimals(0))
                .changed()
            {
                app.settings.log_font_size = size;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }

            ui.separator();
            if ui.button(tr("恢复默认设置")).clicked() {
                app.settings = crate::settings::Settings::default();
                app.log
                    .set_limits(app.settings.max_rows, app.settings.max_raw);
                app.log.set_options(app.settings.display);
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
                app.info(tr("已恢复默认设置"));
            }
            if ui.button(tr("关于")).clicked() {
                app.show_about = true;
            }
        });
    });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Left configuration panel
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    /// Directory holding the settings file.
    pub fn config_dir() -> Option<PathBuf> {
        // Resolved by hand rather than pulling in a `directories` dependency:
        // three small platform rules are easy to keep correct and auditable.
        #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
        {
            std::env::var_os("APPDATA")
                .map(PathBuf::from)
                .map(|p| p.join("xcom"))
        }
        #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
        {
            std::env::var_os("HOME").map(|home| {
                PathBuf::from(home)
                    .join("Library")
                    .join("Application Support")
                    .join("xcom")
            })
        }
        #[cfg(not(any(target_os = "windows", target_os = "macos")))]
        {
            std::env::var_os("XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
                .map(PathBuf::from)
                .or_else(|| std::env::var_os("HOME").map(|h| PathBuf::from(h).join(".config")))
                .map(|p| p.join("xcom"))
        }
    }

    /// Full path of the settings file.
    pub fn path() -> Option<PathBuf> {
        Self::config_dir().map(|dir| dir.join("settings.json"))
    }

    /// Load from disk, falling back to defaults on any problem.
    ///
    /// A corrupt or unreadable settings file must never prevent the program
    /// from starting, so every failure is reported and swallowed.
    pub fn load() -> Self {
        match Self::path() {
            Some(path) => Self::load_from(&path),
            None => Self::default(),
        }
    }

    /// Load from an explicit path.  Split out from [`load`](Self::load) so it
    /// can be tested without touching process-wide environment variables.
    pub fn load_from(path: &std::path::Path) -> Self {
        let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(path) else {
            return Self::default();
        };
        match serde_json::from_str::<Self>(&text) {
            Ok(mut settings) => {
                settings.normalize();
                settings
            }
            Err(err) => {
                log::warn!("配置文件解析失败 ({err})，已使用默认设置");
                Self::default()
            }
        }
    }

    /// Write to disk, creating the directory if needed.
    pub fn save(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
        let path = Self::path().ok_or_else(|| crate::i18n::tr("无法确定配置目录").to_owned())?;
        self.save_to(&path)
    }

    /// Write to an explicit path.
    pub fn save_to(&self, path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<(), String> {
        if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)
                .map_err(|e| crate::i18n::tr1("创建配置目录失败: {}", e))?;
        }
        let text = serde_json::to_string_pretty(self)
            .map_err(|e| crate::i18n::tr1("序列化失败: {}", e))?;
        // Write to a temporary file and rename, so an interrupted save cannot
        // leave a truncated settings file behind.
        let tmp = path.with_extension("json.tmp");
        std::fs::write(&tmp, text).map_err(|e| crate::i18n::tr1("写入失败: {}", e))?;
        std::fs::rename(&tmp, path).map_err(|e| crate::i18n::tr1("替换失败: {}", e))?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn default_round_trips_through_json() {
        let settings = Settings::default();
        let text = serde_json::to_string(&settings).unwrap();
        let back: Settings = serde_json::from_str(&text).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(settings, back);
    }

    #[test]
    fn partial_json_fills_in_defaults() {
        // Simulates a settings file written by an older build.
        let text = r#"{"theme":"Light","send":{"hex":true,"period_ms":250}}"#;
        let settings: Settings = serde_json::from_str(text).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(settings.theme, ThemeMode::Light);
        assert!(settings.send.hex);
        assert_eq!(settings.send.period_ms, 250);
        // Fields absent from the document keep their defaults.
        assert!(settings.send.append_newline);
        assert_eq!(settings.log_font_size, Settings::default().log_font_size);
        assert_eq!(settings.multi.pages.len(), crate::multi::PAGES);
    }

    #[test]
    fn loop_count_persists_and_defaults_to_infinite() {
        assert_eq!(Settings::default().multi.loop_count, None);

        let mut settings = Settings::default();
        settings.multi.loop_count = Some(7);
        let text = serde_json::to_string(&settings).unwrap();
        let back: Settings = serde_json::from_str(&text).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(back.multi.loop_count, Some(7));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_settings_file_missing_newer_fields_still_loads() {
        // Every nested config struct must tolerate fields it does not contain.
        // If one rejects the document, `load_from` falls back to *all* defaults
        // and the user silently loses their entire configuration -- so adding
        // a field in a future version would look like a factory reset.
        let legacy = r#"{
            "theme": "Light",
            "serial": {"port": "/dev/ttyUSB0", "baud": 9600},
            "display": {"mode": "Hex"},
            "multi": {"loop_period_ms": 250},
            "protocol": {"address": 66}
        }"#;
        let settings: Settings =
            serde_json::from_str(legacy).expect("legacy settings must still load");

        assert_eq!(settings.theme, ThemeMode::Light);
        assert_eq!(settings.serial.port, "/dev/ttyUSB0");
        assert_eq!(settings.serial.baud, 9600);
        assert_eq!(settings.multi.loop_period_ms, 250);
        assert_eq!(settings.protocol.address, 66);

        // Fields absent from the document take their defaults.
        assert_eq!(settings.serial.data_bits, crate::serial::DataBitsSel::Eight);
        assert_eq!(settings.multi.loop_count, None);
        assert_eq!(
            settings.protocol.max_retries,
            crate::protocol::ProtocolConfig::default().max_retries
        );
        assert_eq!(settings.display.hex_bytes_per_row, 16);
        assert_eq!(settings.multi.pages.len(), crate::multi::PAGES);
    }

    #[test]
    fn normalize_clamps_hostile_values() {
        let mut settings = Settings {
            log_font_size: 900.0,
            max_rows: 0,
            max_raw: 1,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        settings.send.period_ms = 0;
        settings.normalize();
        assert_eq!(settings.log_font_size, 32.0);
        assert_eq!(settings.send.period_ms, 1);
        assert!(settings.max_rows >= 1_000);
        assert!(settings.max_raw >= 64 * 1024);
    }

    #[test]
    fn newline_bytes_follow_flags() {
        let mut send = SendSettings::default();
        assert_eq!(send.newline_bytes(), b"\r\n");
        send.newline_cr = false;
        assert_eq!(send.newline_bytes(), b"\n");
        send.newline_lf = false;
        assert!(send.newline_bytes().is_empty());
    }

/// The default text styles of the default egui theme.
pub fn default_text_styles() -> BTreeMap<TextStyle, FontId> {
    use FontFamily::{Monospace, Proportional};

    [
        (TextStyle::Small, FontId::new(9.0, Proportional)),
        (TextStyle::Body, FontId::new(13.0, Proportional)),
        (TextStyle::Button, FontId::new(13.0, Proportional)),
        (TextStyle::Heading, FontId::new(18.0, Proportional)),
        (TextStyle::Monospace, FontId::new(13.0, Monospace)),
    ]
    .into()
}

//! Persisted application settings.
//!
//! Everything the user can tweak is stored in a single JSON document under the
//! platform's configuration directory.  The structure is `#[serde(default)]`
//! throughout, so a settings file written by an older build still loads: any
//! field it lacks simply takes its default.

use std::path::PathBuf;

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

use crate::encoding::EncodingChoice;
use crate::i18n::Lang;
use crate::logstore::DisplayOptions;
use crate::multi::MultiSend;
use crate::protocol::ProtocolConfig;
use crate::serial::SerialConfig;
use crate::theme::{LogColorOverride, ThemeMode};

/// Options for the single-send panel.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(default)]
pub struct SendSettings {
    /// 16进制发送.
    pub hex: bool,
    /// 发送新行.
    pub append_newline: bool,
    /// Emit CR as part of the newline.
    pub newline_cr: bool,
    /// Emit LF as part of the newline.
    pub newline_lf: bool,
    /// 定时发送.
    pub timed: bool,
    /// 定时发送周期 (ms).
    pub period_ms: u64,
    /// Recently sent payloads, newest first.
    pub history: Vec<String>,
    /// The send buffer itself, restored on startup.
    pub buffer: String,
}

impl Default for SendSettings {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            hex: false,
            append_newline: true,
            newline_cr: true,
            newline_lf: true,
            timed: false,
            period_ms: 1000,
            history: Vec::new(),
            buffer: String::new(),
        }
    }
}

impl SendSettings {
    /// Cap on remembered payloads.
    pub const MAX_HISTORY: usize = 32;

    /// The newline suffix implied by the flags.
    pub fn newline_bytes(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(2);
        if self.newline_cr {
            out.push(b'\r');
        }
        if self.newline_lf {
            out.push(b'\n');
        }
        out
    }

    /// Remember a payload, de-duplicating and bounding the list.
    pub fn remember(&mut self, payload: &str) {
        if payload.trim().is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        self.history.retain(|h| h != payload);
        self.history.insert(0, payload.to_owned());
        self.history.truncate(Self::MAX_HISTORY);
    }
}

/// The complete persisted state.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(default)]
pub struct Settings {
    pub theme: ThemeMode,
    /// Interface language; `None` means "not chosen yet, follow the system".
    pub lang: Option<Lang>,
    pub log_colors: LogColorOverride,
    pub serial: SerialConfig,
    pub display: DisplayOptions,
    /// Receive decoding: `None` means auto-detect.
    pub encoding: EncodingChoice,
    /// Transmit encoding: `None` means "follow the receive encoding".
    pub tx_encoding: EncodingChoice,
    pub send: SendSettings,
    pub multi: MultiSend,
    pub protocol: ProtocolConfig,
    /// The protocol panel's data field, restored on startup.
    pub protocol_data: String,
    /// Keep the receive view pinned to the newest line.
    pub auto_scroll: bool,
    /// Mirror transmitted data into the receive view.
    pub echo_sent: bool,
    /// Pause the display without dropping bytes.
    pub paused: bool,
    /// Extra spacing between log rows, in points.
    pub line_spacing: f32,
    pub log_font_size: f32,
    /// Maximum retained display rows.
    pub max_rows: usize,
    /// Maximum retained raw bytes.
    pub max_raw: usize,
    /// Width of the serial-settings panel, in points.  Owned by the app rather
    /// than by egui's panel state: see `ui::panels::splitter`.
    pub left_panel_width: f32,
    /// Width of the multi-send / protocol panel.
    pub right_panel_width: f32,
    /// Height of the send area below the log.
    pub send_area_height: f32,
    /// Window size, restored on startup.
    pub window_size: Option<[f32; 2]>,
}

impl Default for Settings {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            theme: ThemeMode::Dark,
            lang: None,
            log_colors: LogColorOverride::default(),
            serial: SerialConfig::default(),
            display: DisplayOptions::default(),
            encoding: None,
            tx_encoding: None,
            send: SendSettings::default(),
            multi: MultiSend::default(),
            protocol: ProtocolConfig::default(),
            protocol_data: String::new(),
            auto_scroll: true,
            echo_sent: true,
            paused: false,
            line_spacing: 0.0,
            log_font_size: 13.0,
            max_rows: 200_000,
            max_raw: 32 * 1024 * 1024,
            left_panel_width: crate::ui::panels::LEFT_PANEL_DEFAULT,
            right_panel_width: crate::ui::panels::RIGHT_PANEL_DEFAULT,
            send_area_height: crate::ui::panels::SEND_AREA_DEFAULT,
            window_size: None,
        }
    }
}

impl Settings {
    /// Clamp anything that could be nonsensical after a hand-edit.
    pub fn normalize(&mut self) {
        self.send.period_ms = self.send.period_ms.clamp(1, 3_600_000);
        self.log_font_size = self.log_font_size.clamp(8.0, 32.0);
        self.line_spacing = self.line_spacing.clamp(0.0, 12.0);
        self.max_rows = self.max_rows.clamp(1_000, 5_000_000);
        self.max_raw = self.max_raw.clamp(64 * 1024, 512 * 1024 * 1024);
        self.multi.normalize();
        self.protocol.normalize();
        self.left_panel_width = self.left_panel_width.clamp(
            crate::ui::panels::LEFT_PANEL_MIN,
            crate::ui::panels::LEFT_PANEL_MAX,
        );
        self.right_panel_width = self.right_panel_width.clamp(
            crate::ui::panels::RIGHT_PANEL_MIN,
            crate::ui::panels::RIGHT_PANEL_MAX,
        );
        self.send_area_height = self.send_area_height.clamp(
            crate::ui::panels::SEND_AREA_MIN,
            crate::ui::panels::SEND_AREA_MAX,
        );
    }

    /// Directory holding the settings file.
//! CJK font discovery.
//!
//! The entire UI is in Chinese, so a font with CJK coverage is mandatory.  The
//! default egui fonts cover Latin only, and bundling a full CJK face would add
//! ~10 MB to every binary.  Instead we locate a system font at startup: first
//! from a list of well-known paths (fast, and covers almost every real desktop)
//! and then by asking `fontdb` for any installed family with a CJK name.
//!
//! If nothing is found the app still runs; Chinese text simply renders as
//! tofu, and the UI says so in the log so the cause is obvious.

use std::sync::Arc;

use eframe::egui;

/// Family names that indicate CJK coverage, in descending preference.
///
/// Ordering matters: a sans-serif with broad coverage is a better UI font than
/// a serif or a handwriting face.
const PREFERRED_FAMILIES: &[&str] = &[
    "Noto Sans CJK SC",
    "Noto Sans SC",
    "Source Han Sans SC",
    "Sarasa Gothic SC",
    "Sarasa Mono SC",

    "Noto Sans CJK TC",
    "Noto Sans CJK JP",
    "SimHei",
    "SimSun",

];

/// Well-known font file paths, tried before the slower database scan.
#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
const KNOWN_PATHS: &[&str] = &[
    "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc",
    "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansSC-Regular.otf",

#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
const KNOWN_PATHS: &[&str] = &[
    "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\msyh.ttc",
    "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\msyh.ttf",
    "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\msyhbd.ttc",
    "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\simhei.ttf",
    "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\simsun.ttc",
    "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\Deng.ttf",
];

#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
const KNOWN_PATHS: &[&str] = &[
    "/System/Library/Fonts/PingFang.ttc",
    "/System/Library/Fonts/STHeiti Light.ttc",
    "/System/Library/Fonts/STHeiti Medium.ttc",
    "/Library/Fonts/Arial Unicode.ttf",

];

/// A loaded font face, ready to hand to egui.
pub struct LoadedFont {
    /// Family name, for display in the UI.
    pub family: String,
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
    /// Face index within a font collection (`.ttc`).
    pub index: u32,
}

/// Well-known UI font paths (Zed / IBM Plex / clean sans).
#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
const KNOWN_UI_PATHS: &[&str] = &[
    "/usr/share/fonts/windows/ZedMonoNerdFontPropo-Regular.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/ibm-plex/IBMPlexSans-Regular.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/ibm-plex/IBMPlexSans-Regular.otf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/windows/ZedMonoNerdFont-Regular.ttf",
];

#[cfg(not(target_os = "linux"))]
const KNOWN_UI_PATHS: &[&str] = &[];

/// Well-known Monospace font paths (Zed Mono / IBM Plex Mono).
#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
const KNOWN_MONO_PATHS: &[&str] = &[
    "/usr/share/fonts/windows/ZedMonoNerdFontMono-Regular.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/windows/ZedMonoNerdFont-Regular.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/ibm-plex/IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/ibm-plex/IBMPlexMono-Regular.otf",
];

#[cfg(not(target_os = "linux"))]
const KNOWN_MONO_PATHS: &[&str] = &[];

/// UI font family preference list.
const PREFERRED_UI_FAMILIES: &[&str] = &[
    "IBM Plex Sans",
    "ZedMono Nerd Font Propo",
    "ZedMono NFP",
    "ZedMono Nerd Font",
    "Inter",
    "Cantarell",
    "Noto Sans",
    "Segoe UI",
];

/// Monospace font family preference list.
const PREFERRED_MONO_FAMILIES: &[&str] = &[
    "ZedMono Nerd Font Mono",
    "ZedMono NFM",
    "ZedMono Nerd Font",
    "IBM Plex Mono",
    "JetBrains Mono",
    "DejaVu Sans Mono",
];

/// Try to find a Zed-like UI font.
pub fn find_ui_font() -> Option<LoadedFont> {
    for path in KNOWN_UI_PATHS {
        if let Ok(data) = std::fs::read(path) {
            if !data.is_empty() {
                return Some(LoadedFont {
                    family: file_stem(path),
                    data,
                    index: 0,
                });
            }
        }
    }
    scan_families(PREFERRED_UI_FAMILIES)
}

/// Try to find a Zed-like Monospace font.
pub fn find_mono_font() -> Option<LoadedFont> {
    for path in KNOWN_MONO_PATHS {
        if let Ok(data) = std::fs::read(path) {
            if !data.is_empty() {
                return Some(LoadedFont {
                    family: file_stem(path),
                    data,
                    index: 0,
                });
            }
        }
    }
    scan_families(PREFERRED_MONO_FAMILIES)
}

/// Family name of the UI font installed at startup.
static INSTALLED_UI_FAMILY: std::sync::OnceLock<Option<String>> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();

/// Family name of the UI font in use.
pub fn installed_ui_family() -> Option<String> {
    INSTALLED_UI_FAMILY.get().cloned().flatten()
}

/// Try to find a CJK-capable system font.
pub fn find_cjk_font() -> Option<LoadedFont> {
    for path in KNOWN_PATHS {
        if let Ok(data) = std::fs::read(path) {
            if !data.is_empty() {
                return Some(LoadedFont {
                    family: file_stem(path),
                    data,
                    index: 0,
                });
            }
        }
    }
    scan_families(PREFERRED_FAMILIES)
}

/// Ask `fontdb` for an installed family from `preferred`.
fn scan_families(preferred: &[&str]) -> Option<LoadedFont> {
    let mut db = fontdb::Database::new();
    db.load_system_fonts();

    for wanted in preferred {
        let family = db
            .faces()
            .find(|face| {
                face.families
                    .iter()
                    .any(|(name, _)| name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(wanted))
            })
            .map(|face| {
                (
                    face.id,
                    face.index,
                    face.families.first().map(|(n, _)| n.clone()),
                )
            });
        let Some((id, index, name)) = family else {
            continue;
        };
        let data = db.with_face_data(id, |bytes, _| bytes.to_vec())?;
        if data.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        return Some(LoadedFont {
            family: name.unwrap_or_else(|| (*wanted).to_owned()),
            data,
            index,
        });
    }
    None
}

impl Settings {
    /// Clamp anything that could be nonsensical after a hand-edit.
    pub fn normalize(&mut self) {
        self.send.period_ms = self.send.period_ms.clamp(1, 3_600_000);
        self.log_font_size = self.log_font_size.clamp(8.0, 32.0);
        self.line_spacing = self.line_spacing.clamp(0.0, 12.0);
        self.max_rows = self.max_rows.clamp(1_000, 5_000_000);
        self.max_raw = self.max_raw.clamp(64 * 1024, 512 * 1024 * 1024);
        self.multi.normalize();
        self.protocol.normalize();
        self.left_panel_width = self.left_panel_width.clamp(
            crate::ui::panels::LEFT_PANEL_MIN,
            crate::ui::panels::LEFT_PANEL_MAX,
        );
        self.right_panel_width = self.right_panel_width.clamp(
            crate::ui::panels::RIGHT_PANEL_MIN,
            crate::ui::panels::RIGHT_PANEL_MAX,
        );
        self.send_area_height = self.send_area_height.clamp(
            crate::ui::panels::SEND_AREA_MIN,
            crate::ui::panels::SEND_AREA_MAX,
        );
    }

    /// Directory holding the settings file.
    pub fn config_dir() -> Option<PathBuf> {
        // Resolved by hand rather than pulling in a `directories` dependency:
        // three small platform rules are easy to keep correct and auditable.
        #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
        {
            std::env::var_os("APPDATA")
                .map(PathBuf::from)
                .map(|p| p.join("xcom"))
        }
        #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
        {
            std::env::var_os("HOME").map(|home| {
                PathBuf::from(home)
                    .join("Library")
                    .join("Application Support")
                    .join("xcom")
            })
        }
        #[cfg(not(any(target_os = "windows", target_os = "macos")))]
        {
            std::env::var_os("XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
                .map(PathBuf::from)
                .or_else(|| std::env::var_os("HOME").map(|h| PathBuf::from(h).join(".config")))
                .map(|p| p.join("xcom"))
        }
    }

    /// Full path of the settings file.
    pub fn path() -> Option<PathBuf> {
        Self::config_dir().map(|dir| dir.join("settings.json"))
    }

    /// Load from disk, falling back to defaults on any problem.
    ///
    /// A corrupt or unreadable settings file must never prevent the program
    /// from starting, so every failure is reported and swallowed.
    pub fn load() -> Self {
        match Self::path() {
            Some(path) => Self::load_from(&path),
            None => Self::default(),
        }
    }

    /// Load from an explicit path.  Split out from [`load`](Self::load) so it
    /// can be tested without touching process-wide environment variables.
    pub fn load_from(path: &std::path::Path) -> Self {
        let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(path) else {
            return Self::default();
        };
        match serde_json::from_str::<Self>(&text) {
            Ok(mut settings) => {
                settings.normalize();
                settings
            }
            Err(err) => {
                log::warn!("配置文件解析失败 ({err})，已使用默认设置");
                Self::default()
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn options(&self) -> &TextOptions {
        self.atlas.options()
    }

    /// Take the recycled shaping buffer (or create a new one if already taken).
    pub fn take_shape_buffer(&mut self) -> harfrust::UnicodeBuffer {
        self.shape_buffer.take().unwrap_or_default()
    }

    /// Return a shaping buffer for reuse.
    pub fn return_shape_buffer(&mut self, buffer: harfrust::UnicodeBuffer) {
        self.shape_buffer = Some(buffer);
    }

    /// Get the right font implementation from [`FontFamily`].
    pub fn font(&mut self, family: &FontFamily) -> Font<'_> {
        let cached_family = self.family_cache.entry(family.clone()).or_insert_with(|| {
            let fonts = &self.definitions.families.get(family);
            let fonts =
                fonts.unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("FontFamily::{family:?} is not bound to any fonts"));

            let fonts: Vec<FontFaceKey> = fonts
                .iter()
                .map(|font_name| {
                    *self
                        .fonts_by_name
                        .get(font_name)
                        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("No font data found for {font_name:?}"))
                })
                .collect();

            CachedFamily::new(fonts, &mut self.fonts_by_id)
        });
        Font {
            fonts_by_id: &mut self.fonts_by_id,
            cached_family,
            atlas: &mut self.atlas,
        }
    }

fn table() -> &'static HashMap<&'static str, &'static str> {
    static TABLE: OnceLock<HashMap<&'static str, &'static str>> = OnceLock::new();
    TABLE.get_or_init(|| EN.iter().copied().collect())

/// Classify a locale string such as `zh_CN.UTF-8`.
///
/// Split out from [`system_lang`] so it can be tested without touching the
/// process environment.
pub fn classify(locale: Option<&str>) -> Lang {
    match locale {
        Some(value) if value.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().starts_with("zh") => Lang::ZhCn,
        _ => Lang::EnUs,
    }
}

/// Guess the language from the environment.
pub fn system_lang() -> Lang {
    for key in ["LC_ALL", "LC_MESSAGES", "LANG"] {
        if let Ok(value) = std::env::var(key) {
            if !value.trim().is_empty() {
                return classify(Some(&value));
            }
        }
    }
    Lang::EnUs
}

/// User selections for the three independently configurable text areas.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(default)]
pub struct FontSettings {
    /// `None` selects the platform's preferred UI font.
    pub ui_family: Option<String>,
    /// `None` selects the preferred monospace font for the receive view.
    pub receive_family: Option<String>,
    /// `None` selects the preferred monospace font for the send editor.
    pub send_family: Option<String>,
    /// Point size used by general interface controls.
    pub ui_size: f32,
    /// Point size used by the receive view.
    pub receive_size: f32,
    /// Point size used by the send editor.
    pub send_size: f32,
}

impl Default for FontSettings {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            ui_family: None,
            receive_family: None,
            send_family: None,
            ui_size: 13.0,
            receive_size: 13.0,
            send_size: 13.0,
        }
    }
}

impl FontSettings {
    fn normalize(&mut self) {
        self.ui_size = self.ui_size.clamp(9.0, 24.0);
        self.receive_size = self.receive_size.clamp(8.0, 32.0);
        self.send_size = self.send_size.clamp(8.0, 32.0);
    }

    fn family_signature(&self) -> (Option<&str>, Option<&str>, Option<&str>) {
        (
            self.ui_family.as_deref(),
            self.receive_family.as_deref(),
            self.send_family.as_deref(),
        )
    }
}

impl SendSettings {
    /// Cap on remembered payloads.
    pub const MAX_HISTORY: usize = 32;

    /// The newline suffix implied by the flags.
    pub fn newline_bytes(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(2);
        if self.newline_cr {
            out.push(b'\r');
        }
        if self.newline_lf {
            out.push(b'\n');
        }
        out
    }

    /// Remember a payload, de-duplicating and bounding the list.
    pub fn remember(&mut self, payload: &str) {
        if payload.trim().is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        self.history.retain(|h| h != payload);
        self.history.insert(0, payload.to_owned());
        self.history.truncate(Self::MAX_HISTORY);
    }
}

/// All installed family names, sorted for the settings combo boxes.
pub fn available_families() -> Vec<String> {
    static FAMILIES: std::sync::OnceLock<Vec<String>> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    FAMILIES.get_or_init(|| {
        let mut db = fontdb::Database::new();
        db.load_system_fonts();
        let mut names = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
        for face in db.faces() {
            for (name, _) in &face.families {
                names.insert(name.clone());
            }
        }
        names.into_iter().collect()
    }).clone()
}

/// Load an exact family chosen by the user.
pub fn find_family(name: &str) -> Option<LoadedFont> {
    let mut db = fontdb::Database::new();
    db.load_system_fonts();
    let face = db.faces().find(|face| {
        face.families
            .iter()
            .any((|(candidate, _)| candidate.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name)))
    })?;
    let data = db.with_face_data(face.id, |bytes, _| bytes.to_vec())?;
    if data.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    Some(LoadedFont {
        family: name.to_owned(),
        data,
        index: face.index,
    })
}

fn add_font(fonts: &mut egui::FontDefinitions, key: &str, font: &LoadedFont) {
    let mut data = egui::FontData::from_owned(font.data.clone());
    data.index = font.index;
    fonts.font_data.insert(key.to_owned(), Arc::new(data));
    fonts
        .families
        .entry(egui::FontFamily::Name(Arc::from(key)))
        .or_default()
        .insert(0, key.to_owned());
}

fn push_cjk_fallback(fonts: &mut egui::FontDefinitions, family: egui::FontFamily) {
    fonts.families.entry(family).or_default().push("cjk".to_owned());
}

/// Font IDs used by the receive and send widgets.
pub fn receive_font_id(size: f32) -> egui::FontId {
    egui::FontId::new(
        size,
        egui::FontFamily::Name(Arc::from(RECEIVE_FONT_FAMILY)),
    )
}

pub fn send_font_id(size: f32) -> egui::FontId {
    egui::FontId::new(size, egui::FontFamily::Name(Arc::from(SEND_FONT_FAMILY)))
}

/// Apply configured point sizes without changing widget visuals.
pub fn apply_text_sizes(ctx: &egui::Context, settings: &FontSettings) {
    ctx.style_mut(|style| {
        style.text_styles = [
            (egui::TextStyle::Small, egui::FontId::proportional(settings.ui_size * 0.69)),
            (egui::TextStyle::Body, egui::FontId::proportional(settings.ui_size)),
            (egui::TextStyle::Button, egui::FontId::proportional(settings.ui_size)),
            (egui::TextStyle::Heading, egui::FontId::proportional(settings.ui_size * 1.38)),
            (egui::TextStyle::Monospace, receive_font_id(settings.receive_size)),
        ]
        .into();
    });
}

/// Bind the named receive/send families to egui's built-in fonts in tests.
///
/// Headless layout tests do not need to scan multi-megabyte system fonts; they
/// only need the custom family names to exist so text layout cannot panic.
#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) fn install_default_families(ctx: &egui::Context) {
    let mut fonts = egui::FontDefinitions::default();
    let monospace = fonts
        .families
        .get(&egui::FontFamily::Monospace)
        .cloned()
        .unwrap_or_default();
    for name in [RECEIVE_FONT_FAMILY, SEND_FONT_FAMILY] {
        fonts
            .families
            .insert(egui::FontFamily::Name(Arc::from(name)), monospace.clone());
    }
    ctx.set_fonts(fonts);
}

/// Load an exact family chosen by the user.
pub fn find_family(name: &str) -> Option<LoadedFont> {
    let mut db = fontdb::Database::new();
    db.load_system_fonts();
    let face = db.faces().find(|face| {
        face.families
            .iter()

        data,
        index: face.index,

impl XcomApp {
    /// Build the application, loading persisted settings.
    pub fn new(cc: &eframe::CreationContext<'_>) -> Self {
        let settings = Settings::load();

        // Restore the window size before the first frame.
        if let Some([w, h]) = settings.window_size {
            cc.egui_ctx
                .send_viewport_cmd(eframe::egui::ViewportCommand::InnerSize(
                    eframe::egui::vec2(w.max(640.0), h.max(420.0)),
                ));
        }

        // Resolve the language before the first frame and remember the choice,
        // so a system-locale guess sticks once the user has seen it.
        let lang = settings.lang.unwrap_or_else(crate::i18n::system_lang);
        crate::i18n::set_lang(lang);

        let mut app = Self::headless(settings);
        if app.settings.lang.is_none() {
            app.settings.lang = Some(lang);
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }

        // Apply the persisted theme now so the first frame is already correct.
        crate::theme::apply(&cc.egui_ctx, app.settings.theme);
        app.applied_theme = Some(app.settings.theme);

        app
    }

    /// Build the application from explicit settings, with no egui context.
    ///
    /// Kept separate from [`new`](Self::new) so the UI can be laid out in a
    /// headless test without an eframe `CreationContext`.
    pub(crate) fn headless(settings: Settings) -> Self {
        let mut app = Self {
            log: LogStore::new(encoding_rs::UTF_8),
            auto: AutoDetector::new(),
            log_view: LogViewState::default(),
            link: SerialLink::new(),
            ports: PortWatcher::spawn(Duration::from_millis(1000)),
            settings,
            rx_bytes: 0,

/// Let the user choose one installed family, with `None` meaning “automatic”.
fn font_combo(ui: &mut Ui, id: &str, current: &mut Option<String>) -> bool {
    let mut changed = false;
    let selected_text = current
        .clone()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| tr("自动").to_owned());
    egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt(id)
        .selected_text(selected_text)
        .width(170.0)
        .height(280.0)
        .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
            if ui
                .selectable_label(current.is_none(), tr("自动"))
                .clicked()
            {
                *current = None;
                changed = true;
            }
            for family in crate::fonts::available_families() {
                let selected = current.as_deref() == Some(family.as_str());
                if ui.selectable_label(selected, family).clicked() {
                    *current = Some(family);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
        });
    changed
}

fn display_section(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
    egui::CollapsingHeader::new(tr("显示设置"))
        .default_open(true)
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            let mut display = app.settings.display;
            let mut changed = false;

            let mut hex = display.mode == ViewMode::Hex;
            if ui.checkbox(&mut hex, tr("16进制显示")).changed() {
                display.mode = if hex { ViewMode::Hex } else { ViewMode::Text };
                changed = true;
            }

            if display.mode == ViewMode::Hex {
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    ui.label(tr("HEX 样式"));
                    let mut style = display.hex_style;
                    if combo(
                        ui,
                        "hex_style",
                        &mut style,
                        &[HexStyle::Stream, HexStyle::Dump],
                        |s| match s {
                            HexStyle::Stream => tr("连续").to_owned(),
                            HexStyle::Dump => tr("16 字节/行").to_owned(),
                        },
                    ) {
                        display.hex_style = style;
                        changed = true;
                    }
                    let mut upper = display.upper_hex;
                    if ui.checkbox(&mut upper, tr("大写")).changed() {
                        display.upper_hex = upper;
                        changed = true;

                if display.hex_style == HexStyle::Dump {
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {

                let mut newly_selected = None;
                egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("rx_encoding")
                    .selected_text(label)
                    .width(160.0)
                    .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                        if ui
                            .selectable_label(choice.is_none(), tr("自动识别"))

                        {
                            newly_selected = Some(None);
                        }
                        for id in EncodingId::ALL {

                                .selectable_label(choice == Some(id), tr(id.label()))
                                .clicked()
                            {
                                newly_selected = Some(Some(id));
                            }
                        }
                    });
                if let Some(selection) = newly_selected {
                    app.set_encoding(selection);

### Additions in This Implementation

- **Automatic encoding detection**: No need to manually guess GBK / UTF-8 / Shift_JIS.
- **Dark + Light themes** (can also follow the system).
- **Chinese/English UI toggle**: switchable from the top bar at any time; follows system `LANG` on first launch; choice is persisted.
- **Receive area text selection**: drag-select with mouse, Ctrl+C copy, Ctrl+A select all (based on glyph metrics, CJK full-width characters select correctly).
- **Virtualized log view**: Only visible lines are rendered, staying smooth during long high-speed reception.
- **Adjustable receive area font size and line spacing**; auto-wrap width follows window resize.
- Configuration file persistence; restores last serial and display settings after restart.

---

## Installation and Running

### Prerequisites

You only need a recent Rust toolchain (**1.82+**, `edition 2021`):
---

## Adaptive Encoding

Text encoding from serial devices is highly inconsistent: 8051/STM32 firmware typically uses **GBK**, ESP-IDF outputs **UTF-8**, and Japanese modules often use **Shift_JIS**. The original tool requires manual selection — pick wrong and you get garbled text.

This implementation provides both **auto-detection** (default) and **manual selection**:

- Auto-detection progressively analyzes the data stream and locks the result:
  1. Pure ASCII is valid for all candidate encodings and never triggers a switch;
  2. Valid multi-byte UTF-8 is immediately identified as UTF-8 (this avoids `chardetng` misidentifying short Chinese UTF-8 as GBK);
  3. After accumulating enough data, re-detection only happens when the current encoding shows obvious garbling (replacement character ratio exceeds 1%);
  4. It never switches to a candidate encoding that decodes worse.
- An incremental decoder handles multi-byte characters split across data packets — no half-characters.
- When switching encoding or HEX/text mode, **received historical data is re-rendered under the new setting** (subject to the cache limit).
- Send encoding defaults to "follow receive encoding" but can be set separately.

The status bar shows the active encoding, e.g., `Auto·UTF-8`.

---

## Protocol Transfer

The protocol is a half-duplex **Send-Ack** mode derived from Modbus RTU. Frame format:

```
| 协议传输（Modbus RTU 变种、Send-Ack） | ✅ | 见 [协议传输](#协议传输) |
| 协议：重发次数、帧周期、校验和/异或/CRC8/CRC16 | ✅ | 算法与官方实现逐字节一致 |
| 协议：单次 / 自动 / 文件发送 | ✅ | |
| 协议：响应区显示原始帧 / 自动换行 | ✅ | |
| **界面广告** | ➖ | **按要求移除** |

### 本实现新增

- **编码自动识别**：无需手动猜测 GBK / UTF-8 / Shift_JIS。
- **黑色 + 白色主题**（并可跟随系统）。
- **中英文界面切换**：顶栏可随时切换，首次启动跟随系统 `LANG`，选择会持久化。
- **接收区文本选择**：鼠标拖选、Ctrl+C 复制、Ctrl+A 全选（基于字形度量，中文等宽字符也能正确选中）。
- **虚拟化日志视图**：只渲染可见行，长时间高速接收依然流畅。
- **接收区字号、行距可调**；自动换行宽度随窗口变化。
- 配置文件持久化，重启后恢复上次的串口与显示设置。

---

## 安装与运行

### 依赖
### 中文字体

界面为中文，程序启动时会自动查找系统中的 CJK 字体，查找顺序为：

1. 常见字体路径（如 `/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc`、
   `C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc`、`/System/Library/Fonts/PingFang.ttc`）；
2. 通过 `fontdb` 扫描系统字体，匹配 Noto Sans CJK / 思源黑体 / 微软雅黑 / 苹方 / 文泉驿等。

若都找不到，程序仍可运行，但中文会显示为方块，并在状态栏提示安装字体
（Linux 可安装 `fonts-noto-cjk` 或 `fonts-wqy-microhei`）。

---

## 编码自适应

串口设备的文本编码非常混乱：8051/STM32 固件多为 **GBK**，ESP-IDF 输出 **UTF-8**，
日本模块常用 **Shift_JIS**。原版工具需要手动选择，选错就是满屏乱码。

本实现提供**自动识别**（默认）与**手动指定**两种方式：

- 自动识别逐步分析数据流，并对结果加锁：
cargo test              # 187 tests
cargo clippy --all-targets
cargo fmt
```

Test coverage:

- Hex parsing/formatting, four checksum algorithms (including standard test vectors and real captured frames);
- Log store line splitting, CRLF across packets, auto-wrap (including CJK double-width), timestamp frame-delimiting, cache trimming;
- Encoding auto-detection (UTF-8 / GBK Chinese streams) and cross-packet multi-byte decoding;
- Protocol state machine: response, retransmission, file chunking and ordering;
- **Real PTY loopback**: opening a device, sending/receiving bytes, write counters, re-opening, handshake lines — covering reader/writer threads and event channels;
- **Headless UI layout**: using `Context::run_ui` to render a full frame, covering empty logs, both themes, all display modes, bilingual, narrow-window combinations, and asserting primitives are actually produced;
- **Multi-send column widths**: asserting column widths grow as the panel widens and their sum never exceeds the panel width;
- **Loop count**: asserting that a configured N-count stops after N rounds, infinite loops don't stop, and no checked entries causes a stop;
- **Config backward compatibility**: asserting that old config files missing new fields still load (otherwise all settings would silently reset);
- **UI layer no untranslated text**: scanning `src/ui/`, any Chinese literal not wrapped in `tr()` causes the test to fail;
- **Splitter drag**: simulating real pointer event sequences, asserting all three splitters can be dragged both ways, content changes accordingly, overflow is clamped, and sizes persist;
- **Real serial send/receive**: opening a port with PTY, driving timed send and asserting the peer receives repeated payloads, and that send echo indeed enters the receive area without polluting the receive stream;
- **Config backward compatibility**: asserting that old configs missing new fields still load.

### Code Structure

```
src/
  main.rs          Entry point, font installation
  app.rs           App state, serial/timer event pump, shortcuts
  logstore.rs      Receive log: byte stream → display lines (incremental, bounded, re-renderable)
  encoding.rs      Encoding table, auto-detector, streaming decoder
  hex.rs           Lenient hex parsing and formatting
  multi.rs         Multi-send entries and pages, import/export

## 开发

```bash
cargo test              # 187 个测试
cargo clippy --all-targets
cargo fmt
```

测试覆盖：

- 十六进制解析/格式化、四处校验算法（含标准校验向量与真实抓包帧）；
- 日志存储的行分割、CRLF 跨包、自动换行（含中文双列宽）、时间戳断帧、缓存裁剪；
- 编码自动识别（UTF-8 / GBK 中文流）与跨包多字节解码；
- 协议状态机的应答、重发、文件分片与顺序；
- **真实 PTY 回环**：打开设备、收发字节、写计数、重开、握手线——覆盖 reader/writer 线程与事件通道；
- **无头 UI 布局**：用 `Context::run_ui` 渲染完整一帧，覆盖空日志、两种主题、全部显示模式、
  双语、极窄窗口等组合，并断言确实产出了图元；
- **多条发送列宽**：断言列宽随面板变宽而增长，且各列之和始终不超出面板宽度；
- **循环次数**：断言配置 N 次后在 N 轮结束时停止、无限循环不会停止、无勾选条目时停止；
- **配置向后兼容**：断言缺少新字段的旧配置文件仍能加载（否则会静默重置全部设置）；
- **UI 层无未翻译文案**：扫描 `src/ui/`，任何未包进 `tr()` 的中文字面量都会让测试失败；
- **分隔条拖拽**：模拟真实指针事件序列，断言三个分隔条都能双向拖动、内容随之改变、越界被夹紧、并且尺寸会保持；
- **真实串口收发**：用 PTY 打开端口、驱动定时发送并断言对端收到重复载荷，以及发送回显确实进入接收区且不污染接收流；
- **配置向后兼容**：断言缺少新字段的旧配置仍能加载。

// Safe, because we hash the value in the constructor.
impl nohash_hasher::IsEnabled for FontFaceKey {}

/// Cached data for working with a font family (e.g. doing character lookups).
#[derive(Debug)]
pub(super) struct CachedFamily {
    pub fonts: Vec<FontFaceKey>,

    /// Lazily calculated.
    pub characters: Option<BTreeMap<char, Vec<String>>>,

    /// The face used when no face in [`Self::fonts`] supports a char.
    pub replacement_face_key: FontFaceKey,

    /// The char that [`Self::replacement_face_key`] actually contains.
    ///
    /// When the user asks about a char that no fallback face supports we
    /// render this char in its place.
    pub replacement_char: char,

    /// Cache: `char → which face in the fallback chain owns this char`.
    ///
    /// Location-independent (fallback choice depends only on charmap support,
    /// not on variation coordinates).
    pub face_cache: ahash::HashMap<char, FontFaceKey>,
}

impl CachedFamily {
    fn new(
        fonts: Vec<FontFaceKey>,
        fonts_by_id: &mut nohash_hasher::IntMap<FontFaceKey, FontFace>,
    ) -> Self {
        const PRIMARY_REPLACEMENT_CHAR: char = '◻'; // white medium square
        const FALLBACK_REPLACEMENT_CHAR: char = '?'; // fallback for the fallback

        if fonts.is_empty() {
            return Self {
                fonts,
                characters: None,
                replacement_face_key: FontFaceKey::INVALID,
                replacement_char: PRIMARY_REPLACEMENT_CHAR,
                face_cache: Default::default(),
            };
        }

        let mut slf = Self {
            fonts,
            characters: None,
            replacement_face_key: FontFaceKey::INVALID,
            replacement_char: PRIMARY_REPLACEMENT_CHAR,
            face_cache: Default::default(),
        };

        let (replacement_face_key, replacement_char) = slf
            .find_face_for_char(PRIMARY_REPLACEMENT_CHAR, fonts_by_id)
            .map(|key| (key, PRIMARY_REPLACEMENT_CHAR))
            .or_else(|| {
                slf.find_face_for_char(FALLBACK_REPLACEMENT_CHAR, fonts_by_id)
                    .map(|key| (key, FALLBACK_REPLACEMENT_CHAR))
            })
            .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                log::warn!(
                    "Failed to find replacement characters {PRIMARY_REPLACEMENT_CHAR:?} or {FALLBACK_REPLACEMENT_CHAR:?}. Will use empty glyph."
                );
                (FontFaceKey::INVALID, PRIMARY_REPLACEMENT_CHAR)
            });
        slf.replacement_face_key = replacement_face_key;
        slf.replacement_char = replacement_char;

        slf
    }

        // TODO(emilk): this is a false negative if the user asks about the replacement character itself 🤦‍♂️
        self.resolve_face(c) != self.cached_family.replacement_face_key
    }

    /// Can we display all the glyphs in this text?
    pub fn has_glyphs(&mut self, s: &str) -> bool {
        s.chars().all(|c| self.has_glyph(c))
    }

    /// Find which face in the fallback chain owns `c`.
    ///
    /// Location-independent — fallback choice depends only on charmap support.
    /// Falls back to the replacement-glyph face when no fallback face has `c`.
    #[inline]
    pub(crate) fn resolve_face(&mut self, c: char) -> FontFaceKey {
        if let Some(font_key) = self.cached_family.face_cache.get(&c) {
            return *font_key;
        }
        self.resolve_face_slow(c)
    }

    #[cold]
    fn resolve_face_slow(&mut self, c: char) -> FontFaceKey {
        let font_key = self
            .cached_family
            .find_face_for_char(c, self.fonts_by_id)
            .unwrap_or(self.cached_family.replacement_face_key);
        self.cached_family.face_cache.insert(c, font_key);
        font_key
    }

    /// Two passes matter: the first populates panel state (scroll areas, grid

    fn render(app: &mut XcomApp, ctx: &egui::Context, what: &str) {
        for pass in 0..2 {
            let mut output = ctx.run_ui(input(), |ui| app.draw(ui));
            let shapes = output.shapes.len();
            // A real renderer applies these; the test only cares that the frame
            // laid out, so discard them explicitly rather than leaking.
            output.textures_delta.clear();
            assert!(shapes > 0, "{what}: pass {pass} produced no shapes");
        }

    #[test]
    fn settings_that_need_a_control_have_one_in_the_ui() {
        // The echo feature shipped with the setting wired through the store and
        // the send path but *no* control anywhere, so the user could neither
        // see nor change it.  Every behavioural test passed because they set
        // the field directly.  This checks the other half: that the panels
        // actually offer a control for each setting a user is meant to reach.
        let panels =
            std::fs::read_to_string(concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/src/ui/panels.rs"))
                .expect("panels.rs is readable");
        for field in [
            "echo_sent",
            "auto_scroll",
            "line_spacing",
            "fonts.ui_family",
            "fonts.receive_family",
            "fonts.send_family",
            "fonts.ui_size",
            "fonts.receive_size",
            "fonts.send_size",
            "loop_enabled",
            "loop_count",
        ] {
            // The write, not merely a mention: reading a field proves nothing
            // about whether a control can change it.
            assert!(
                panels.contains(&format!("{field} = ")),
                "settings.{field} has no control that sets it"
            );
        }
    }

                        .add(egui::Slider::new(&mut size, 8.0..=32.0).fixed_decimals(0))
                        .changed();
                    fonts.send_size = size;
                    ui.end_row();
                });
            if font_changed {
                fonts.normalize();
                app.settings.fonts = fonts;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }

            if changed {
                app.settings.display = display;
                app.log.set_options(display);
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }

            // The clear/save actions live in the receive toolbar, right next
            // to the data they act on; repeating them here was redundant.
        });
}

//! CJK font discovery.
//!
//! The entire UI is in Chinese, so a font with CJK coverage is mandatory.  The
//! default egui fonts cover Latin only, and bundling a full CJK face would add
//! ~10 MB to every binary.  Instead we locate a system font at startup: first
//! from a list of well-known paths (fast, and covers almost every real desktop)
//! and then by asking `fontdb` for any installed family with a CJK name.
//!
//! If nothing is found the app still runs; Chinese text simply renders as
//! tofu, and the UI says so in the log so the cause is obvious.

use std::sync::Arc;

use eframe::egui;

use crate::settings::FontSettings;

/// Family names that indicate CJK coverage, in descending preference.
///
/// Ordering matters: a sans-serif with broad coverage is a better UI font than
/// a serif or a handwriting face.

    "Noto Sans CJK JP",

    "SimSun",
    "Arial Unicode MS",
];

/// Well-known font file paths, tried before the slower database scan.
#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
const KNOWN_PATHS: &[&str] = &[
    "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc",
    "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansSC-Regular.otf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSansSC-Regular.ttf",

#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
const KNOWN_PATHS: &[&str] = &[
    "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\msyh.ttc",

/// A loaded font face, ready to hand to egui.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct LoadedFont {
    /// Family name, for display in the UI.
    pub family: String,
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
    /// Face index within a font collection (`.ttc`).
    pub index: u32,
}

/// Stable egui family names for the two independently selectable text areas.
///
/// egui supports named font families, which lets the receive and send editors
/// use different faces without changing the interface font.
pub const RECEIVE_FONT_FAMILY: &str = "xcom-receive";
pub const SEND_FONT_FAMILY: &str = "xcom-send";

/// Well-known UI font paths (Zed / IBM Plex / clean sans).
#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
const KNOWN_UI_PATHS: &[&str] = &[
    "/usr/share/fonts/windows/ZedMonoNerdFontPropo-Regular.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/ibm-plex/IBMPlexSans-Regular.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/ibm-plex/IBMPlexSans-Regular.otf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/windows/ZedMonoNerdFont-Regular.ttf",
];

#[cfg(not(target_os = "linux"))]
const KNOWN_UI_PATHS: &[&str] = &[];

/// Well-known Monospace font paths (Zed Mono / IBM Plex Mono).
#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
const KNOWN_MONO_PATHS: &[&str] = &[
    "/usr/share/fonts/windows/ZedMonoNerdFontMono-Regular.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/windows/ZedMonoNerdFont-Regular.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/ibm-plex/IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/ibm-plex/IBMPlexMono-Regular.otf",
];

#[cfg(not(target_os = "linux"))]
const KNOWN_MONO_PATHS: &[&str] = &[];

/// UI font family preference list.
const PREFERRED_UI_FAMILIES: &[&str] = &[
    "IBM Plex Sans",
    "ZedMono Nerd Font Propo",
    "ZedMono NFP",
    "ZedMono Nerd Font",
    "Inter",
    "Cantarell",
    "Noto Sans",
    "Segoe UI",
];

/// Monospace font family preference list.
const PREFERRED_MONO_FAMILIES: &[&str] = &[
    "Noto Sans Mono CJK SC",
    "Sarasa Mono SC",
    "Source Han Mono SC",
    "ZedMono Nerd Font Mono",
    "ZedMono NFM",
    "ZedMono Nerd Font",
    "IBM Plex Mono",

];

/// All installed family names, sorted for the settings combo boxes.
pub fn available_families() -> Vec<String> {
    static FAMILIES: std::sync::OnceLock<Vec<String>> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    FAMILIES
        .get_or_init(|| {
            let mut db = fontdb::Database::new();
            db.load_system_fonts();
            let mut names = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
            for face in db.faces() {
                for (name, _) in &face.families {
                    names.insert(name.clone());
                }
            }
            names.into_iter().collect()
        })
        .clone()
}

/// Load an exact family chosen by the user.
pub fn find_family(name: &str) -> Option<LoadedFont> {
    let mut db = fontdb::Database::new();
    db.load_system_fonts();
    let face = db.faces().find(|face| {
        face.families
            .iter()
            .any(|(candidate, _)| candidate.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name))
    })?;
    let data = db.with_face_data(face.id, |bytes, _| bytes.to_vec())?;
    if data.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    Some(LoadedFont {
        family: name.to_owned(),
        data,
        index: face.index,
    })
}

/// Try to find a Zed-like UI font.
pub fn find_ui_font() -> Option<LoadedFont> {
    for path in KNOWN_UI_PATHS {
        if let Ok(data) = std::fs::read(path) {
            if !data.is_empty() {
                return Some(LoadedFont {
                    family: file_stem(path),
                    data,
                    index: 0,
                });
            .find(|face| {
                face.families
                    .iter()
                    .any(|(name, _)| name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(wanted))
            })
            .map(|face| (face.id, face.index, (*wanted).to_owned()));
        let Some((id, index, name)) = family else {
            continue;
        };
        let data = db.with_face_data(id, |bytes, _| bytes.to_vec())?;
        if data.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        return Some(LoadedFont {
            family: name,
            data,
            index,
        });
    }
    None
}

/// Extract the file name without its extension.
///
/// Both separators are handled explicitly rather than deferring to
/// `Path::file_stem`, so the Windows path list produces sensible names even
/// when this code is compiled and tested on Unix.
fn file_stem(path: &str) -> String {
    let name = path.rsplit(['/', '\\']).next().unwrap_or(path);
    match name.rsplit_once('.') {
        Some((stem, _)) if !stem.is_empty() => stem.to_owned(),
        _ => name.to_owned(),
    }
}

/// The result of installing fonts into an egui context.
pub enum FontStatus {
    /// A CJK font was installed.
    Loaded(String),
    /// No CJK font was found; Chinese text will not render.
    Missing,
}

/// Family name of the font installed at startup.
///
/// Cached rather than re-discovered: the lookup reads a multi-megabyte font
/// file, so it must happen exactly once.
static INSTALLED_FAMILY: std::sync::OnceLock<Option<String>> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();

/// Family name of the CJK font in use, or `None` when none was found.
pub fn installed_family() -> Option<String> {
    INSTALLED_FAMILY.get().cloned().flatten()
}

fn add_font(fonts: &mut egui::FontDefinitions, key: &str, font: &LoadedFont) {
    let mut data = egui::FontData::from_owned(font.data.clone());
    data.index = font.index;
    fonts.font_data.insert(key.to_owned(), Arc::new(data));
    fonts
        .families
        .entry(egui::FontFamily::Name(Arc::from(key)))
        .or_default()
        .insert(0, key.to_owned());
}

fn push_cjk_fallback(fonts: &mut egui::FontDefinitions, family: egui::FontFamily) {
    fonts
        .families
        .entry(family)
        .or_default()
        .push("cjk".to_owned());
}

/// Font IDs used by the receive and send widgets.
pub fn receive_font_id(size: f32) -> egui::FontId {
    egui::FontId::new(size, egui::FontFamily::Name(Arc::from(RECEIVE_FONT_FAMILY)))
}

pub fn send_font_id(size: f32) -> egui::FontId {
    egui::FontId::new(size, egui::FontFamily::Name(Arc::from(SEND_FONT_FAMILY)))
}

/// Apply configured point sizes without changing widget visuals.
pub fn apply_text_sizes(ctx: &egui::Context, settings: &FontSettings) {
    ctx.global_style_mut(|style| {
        style.text_styles = [
            (
                egui::TextStyle::Small,
                egui::FontId::proportional(settings.ui_size * 0.69),
            ),
            (
                egui::TextStyle::Body,
                egui::FontId::proportional(settings.ui_size),
            ),
            (
                egui::TextStyle::Button,
                egui::FontId::proportional(settings.ui_size),
            ),
            (
                egui::TextStyle::Heading,
                egui::FontId::proportional(settings.ui_size * 1.38),
            ),
            (
                egui::TextStyle::Monospace,
                receive_font_id(settings.receive_size),
            ),
        ]
        .into();
    });
}

/// Bind the named receive/send families to egui's built-in fonts in tests.
///
/// Headless layout tests do not need to scan multi-megabyte system fonts; they
/// only need the custom family names to exist so text layout cannot panic.
#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) fn install_default_families(ctx: &egui::Context) {
    let mut fonts = egui::FontDefinitions::default();
    let monospace = fonts
        .families
        .get(&egui::FontFamily::Monospace)
        .cloned()
        .unwrap_or_default();
    for name in [RECEIVE_FONT_FAMILY, SEND_FONT_FAMILY] {
        fonts
            .families
            .insert(egui::FontFamily::Name(Arc::from(name)), monospace.clone());
    }
    ctx.set_fonts(fonts);
}

/// Install the application font stack.
///
/// Zed default UI font is made primary for proportional text, Zed Mono for
/// monospace text, and the CJK face is appended as fallback for both.
pub fn install(ctx: &egui::Context, settings: &FontSettings) -> FontStatus {
    let mut fonts = egui::FontDefinitions::default();

    let cjk = find_cjk_font();
    let ui_font = settings
        .ui_family
        .as_deref()
        .and_then(find_family)
        .or_else(|| cjk.clone())
        .or_else(find_ui_font);
    if let Some(ui_font) = ui_font {
        add_font(&mut fonts, "ui", &ui_font);
        fonts
            .families
            .entry(egui::FontFamily::Proportional)
            .or_default()
            .insert(0, "ui".to_owned());
        let _ = INSTALLED_UI_FAMILY.set(Some(ui_font.family));
    } else {
        let _ = INSTALLED_UI_FAMILY.set(None);
    }

    let default_mono = find_mono_font();
    if let Some(mono_font) = default_mono.clone() {
        add_font(&mut fonts, "mono", &mono_font);
        fonts
            .families
            .entry(egui::FontFamily::Monospace)
            .or_default()
            .insert(0, "mono".to_owned());
    }

    if let Some(ref font) = cjk {
        let mut data = egui::FontData::from_owned(font.data.clone());
        data.index = font.index;
        fonts.font_data.insert("cjk".to_owned(), Arc::new(data));

        push_cjk_fallback(&mut fonts, egui::FontFamily::Proportional);
        push_cjk_fallback(&mut fonts, egui::FontFamily::Monospace);
    }

    let receive_font = settings
        .receive_family
        .as_deref()
        .and_then(find_family)
        .or(default_mono.clone());
    let send_font = settings
        .send_family
        .as_deref()
        .and_then(find_family)
        .or(default_mono);
    if let Some(font) = receive_font {
        add_font(&mut fonts, RECEIVE_FONT_FAMILY, &font);
    }
    if let Some(font) = send_font {
        add_font(&mut fonts, SEND_FONT_FAMILY, &font);
    }
    push_cjk_fallback(
        &mut fonts,
        egui::FontFamily::Name(Arc::from(RECEIVE_FONT_FAMILY)),
    );
    push_cjk_fallback(
        &mut fonts,
        egui::FontFamily::Name(Arc::from(SEND_FONT_FAMILY)),
    );

    // The fallback list may already exist if a custom family was unavailable.
    // Keeping exactly one `cjk` entry makes the definition deterministic.
    for family in [
        egui::FontFamily::Proportional,
        egui::FontFamily::Monospace,
        egui::FontFamily::Name(Arc::from(RECEIVE_FONT_FAMILY)),
        egui::FontFamily::Name(Arc::from(SEND_FONT_FAMILY)),
    ] {
        if let Some(list) = fonts.families.get_mut(&family) {
            list.dedup();
        }
    }
    ctx.set_fonts(fonts);

    match cjk {
        Some(font) => {
            let _ = INSTALLED_FAMILY.set(Some(font.family.clone()));
            FontStatus::Loaded(font.family)
        }
        None => {
            let _ = INSTALLED_FAMILY.set(None);
            FontStatus::Missing
        }
    }
}

+/// Let the user choose one installed family, with `None` meaning “automatic”.
+fn font_combo(ui: &mut Ui, id: &str, current: &mut Option<String>) -> bool {
+    let mut changed = false;
+    let selected_text = current.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| tr("自动").to_owned());
+    egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt(id)
+        .selected_text(selected_text)
+        .width(170.0)
+        .height(280.0)
+        .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
+            if ui.selectable_label(current.is_none(), tr("自动")).clicked() {
+                *current = None;
+                changed = true;
+            }
+            for family in crate::fonts::available_families() {
+                let selected = current.as_deref() == Some(family.as_str());
+                if ui.selectable_label(selected, family.clone()).clicked() {
+                    *current = Some(family);
+                    changed = true;
+                }
+            }
+        });
+    changed
+}

+/// Let the user choose one installed family, with `None` meaning “automatic”.
+fn font_combo(ui: &mut Ui, id: &str, current: &mut Option<String>) -> bool {
+    let mut changed = false;
+    let selected_text = current.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| tr("自动").to_owned());
+    egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt(id)
+        .selected_text(selected_text)
+        .width(170.0)
+        .height(280.0)
+        .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
+            if ui.selectable_label(current.is_none(), tr("自动")).clicked() {
+                *current = None;
+                changed = true;
+            }
+            for family in crate::fonts::available_families() {
+                let selected = current.as_deref() == Some(family.as_str());
+                if ui.selectable_label(selected, family.clone()).clicked() {
+                    *current = Some(family);
+                    changed = true;
+                }
+            }
+        });
+    changed
+}

                        });
                    }
                    ui.end_row();

                    ui.label(tr("DTR / RTS"));
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        let mut dtr = app.settings.serial.dtr;
                        if ui.checkbox(&mut dtr, "DTR").changed() {
                            app.settings.serial.dtr = dtr;
                            if open {
                                if let Err(err) = app.link.set_dtr(dtr) {
                                    app.error(crate::i18n::tr1("设置 DTR 失败: {}", err));
                                }
                            }
                            app.mark_settings_dirty();
                        }
                        let mut rts = app.settings.serial.rts;
                        if ui.checkbox(&mut rts, "RTS").changed() {
                            app.settings.serial.rts = rts;
                            if open {
                                if let Err(err) = app.link.set_rts(rts) {
                                    app.error(crate::i18n::tr1("设置 RTS 失败: {}", err));
                                }
                            }
                            app.mark_settings_dirty();
                        }
                    });
                    ui.end_row();
                });

            ui.add_space(4.0);
            let (label, color) = if open {
                (tr("关闭串口"), egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xE5, 0x53, 0x53))
            } else {
                (tr("打开串口"), egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x4C, 0xAF, 0x50))
            };
            // Do not let the button stretch to the panel edge: a full-width
            // button reads as a separator rather than a control.  Cap it and
            // leave a clear gap.
            let button_width = (serial_bounds.width() - 24.0).clamp(96.0, 168.0);
            let button_center = egui::pos2(serial_bounds.center().x, ui.cursor().min.y + 14.0);
            let open_button = ui.put(
                egui::Rect::from_center_size(button_center, egui::vec2(button_width, 28.0)),
                egui::Button::new(RichText::new(label).strong().color(color)),
            );
            probe::set_open_button_rect(open_button.rect);
            if open_button.clicked() {
                app.toggle_port();
            }
            ui.small(crate::i18n::tr1("当前: {}", app.settings.serial.summary()));
            ui.small(tr("提示: 串口打开时无法修改通信参数，需先关闭串口"));
        });
}

fn display_section(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
    egui::CollapsingHeader::new(tr("显示设置"))
        .default_open(true)
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            let mut display = app.settings.display;
            let mut changed = false;

            let mut hex = display.mode == ViewMode::Hex;
            if ui.checkbox(&mut hex, tr("16进制显示")).changed() {
                display.mode = if hex { ViewMode::Hex } else { ViewMode::Text };
                changed = true;
            }

            if display.mode == ViewMode::Hex {
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    ui.label(tr("HEX 样式"));
                    let mut style = display.hex_style;
                    if combo(
                        ui,
                        "hex_style",
                        &mut style,
                        &[HexStyle::Stream, HexStyle::Dump],
                        |s| match s {
                            HexStyle::Stream => tr("连续").to_owned(),
                            HexStyle::Dump => tr("16 字节/行").to_owned(),
                        },
                    ) {
                        display.hex_style = style;
                        changed = true;
                    }
                    let mut upper = display.upper_hex;
                    if ui.checkbox(&mut upper, tr("大写")).changed() {
                        display.upper_hex = upper;
                        changed = true;
                    }
                });
                if display.hex_style == HexStyle::Dump {
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        ui.label(tr("每行字节"));
                        let mut per_row = display.hex_bytes_per_row;
                        if ui
                            .add(egui::DragValue::new(&mut per_row).range(1..=64))
                            .changed()
                        {
                            display.hex_bytes_per_row = per_row;
                            changed = true;
                        }
                    });
                }
            }

            let mut timestamp = display.timestamp;
            if ui.checkbox(&mut timestamp, tr("时间戳")).changed() {
                display.timestamp = timestamp;
                changed = true;
            }
            if display.timestamp {
                ui.small(tr("以回车换行断帧；数据中若不含回车换行则不会显示时间戳"));
            }

            let mut wrap = display.wrap;
            if ui.checkbox(&mut wrap, tr("自动换行")).changed() {
                display.wrap = wrap;
                changed = true;
            }

            let mut auto_scroll = app.settings.auto_scroll;
            if ui
                .checkbox(&mut auto_scroll, tr("自动滚动到最新"))
                .changed()
            {
                app.settings.auto_scroll = auto_scroll;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }

            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                ui.label(tr("行距"));
                let mut spacing = app.settings.line_spacing;
                if ui
                    .add(egui::Slider::new(&mut spacing, 0.0..=10.0).fixed_decimals(0))
                    .changed()
                {
                    app.settings.line_spacing = spacing;
                    app.mark_settings_dirty();
                }
            });

            ui.separator();
            ui.strong(tr("字体设置"));
            let mut fonts = app.settings.fonts.clone();
            let mut font_changed = false;
            egui::Grid::new("font_grid")
                .num_columns(2)
                .spacing([8.0, 6.0])
                .show(ui, |ui| {
                    ui.label(tr("界面字体"));
                    let mut family = fonts.ui_family.clone();
                    font_changed |= font_combo(ui, "ui_font_family", &mut family);
                    fonts.ui_family = family;
                    ui.end_row();

                    ui.label(tr("界面字号"));
                    let mut size = fonts.ui_size;
                    font_changed |= ui
                        .add(egui::Slider::new(&mut size, 9.0..=24.0).fixed_decimals(0))
                        .changed();
                    fonts.ui_size = size;
                    ui.end_row();

                    ui.label(tr("接收区字体"));
                    let mut family = fonts.receive_family.clone();
                    font_changed |= font_combo(ui, "receive_font_family", &mut family);
                    fonts.receive_family = family;
                    ui.end_row();

                    ui.label(tr("接收区字号"));
                    let mut size = fonts.receive_size;
                    font_changed |= ui
                        .add(egui::Slider::new(&mut size, 8.0..=32.0).fixed_decimals(0))
                        .changed();
                    fonts.receive_size = size;
                    ui.end_row();

                    ui.label(tr("发送区字体"));
                    let mut family = fonts.send_family.clone();
                    font_changed |= font_combo(ui, "send_font_family", &mut family);
                    fonts.send_family = family;
                    ui.end_row();

                    ui.label(tr("发送区字号"));
                    let mut size = fonts.send_size;
                    font_changed |= ui
                        .add(egui::Slider::new(&mut size, 8.0..=32.0).fixed_decimals(0))
                        .changed();
                    fonts.send_size = size;
                    ui.end_row();
                });
            if font_changed {
                fonts.normalize();
                app.settings.fonts = fonts;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }

            if changed {
                app.settings.display = display;
                app.log.set_options(display);
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }

            // The clear/save actions live in the receive toolbar, right next
            // to the data they act on; repeating them here was redundant.
        });
}

fn encoding_section(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
    egui::CollapsingHeader::new(tr("编码设置"))
        .default_open(true)
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                ui.label(tr("接收编码"));
                let choice = app.settings.encoding;
                let label = match choice {
                    None => crate::i18n::tr1("自动识别（{}）", app.encoding_label()),
                    Some(id) => tr(id.label()).to_owned(),
                };
                let mut newly_selected = None;
                egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("rx_encoding")
                    .selected_text(label)
                    .width(160.0)
                    .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                        if ui
                            .selectable_label(choice.is_none(), tr("自动识别"))
                            .clicked()
                        {
                            newly_selected = Some(None);
                        }
                        for id in EncodingId::ALL {
                            if ui
                                .selectable_label(choice == Some(id), tr(id.label()))
                                .clicked()
                            {
                                newly_selected = Some(Some(id));
                            }
                        }
    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
        let label = if app.show_paused {
            tr("继续显示")
        } else {
            tr("暂停显示")
        };
        if ui.button(label).clicked() {
            if app.show_paused {
                app.resume_display();
            } else {
                app.show_paused = true;
                app.info(tr("显示已暂停，数据仍在后台接收"));
            }
        }

        let copy_enabled = app.log_view.has_selection();
        if ui
            .add_enabled(copy_enabled, egui::Button::new(tr("复制选中")))
            .clicked()
        {
            copy_selection(app, ui);
        }
        if ui.button(tr("全选")).clicked() {
            let store = &app.log;
            app.log_view.select_all(store);
        }
        if ui.button(tr("清除接收")).clicked() {
            app.clear_receive();
        }
        if ui.button(tr("保存接收数据")).clicked() {
            save_log(app);
        }
        if ui.button(tr("保存原始数据")).clicked() {
            save_raw_log(app);
        }

        ui.separator();
        let mut echo = app.settings.echo_sent;
        if ui
            .checkbox(&mut echo, tr("回显发送"))
            .on_hover_text(tr("把发出的内容显示在接收区，便于确认是否真的发出"))
            .changed()
        {
            app.settings.echo_sent = echo;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        ui.separator();
        ui.label(RichText::new(app.encoding_label()).monospace());
        if app.log_view.has_selection() {
            ui.label(
                RichText::new(tr("已选中，Ctrl+C 复制"))
                    .small()
                    .color(ui.visuals().weak_text_color()),
            );
        }
    });
}

/// Copy the current selection to the system clipboard.
fn copy_selection(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &Ui) {
    let text = {
        let XcomApp { log, log_view, .. } = app;
        log_view.selected_text(log)
    };
    match text {
        Some(text) => {
            ui.ctx().copy_text(text);
            app.ok(tr("已复制选中内容到剪贴板"));
        }
        None => app.warn(tr("没有可复制的内容")),
    }
}

/// Lay out only the send editor and report the height it took, so a test can
