fn send_area(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
    probe::set_send_panel_rect(ui.max_rect());
    probe::begin_send_toolbar();

    // Toolbar row height: tall enough that text/checkboxes are not clipped.
    const BTN_HEIGHT: f32 = 28.0;
    // Right margin between the 发送 button and the panel edge.
    const RIGHT_PAD: f32 = 6.0;

    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.set_height(BTN_HEIGHT);
        ui.spacing_mut().item_spacing = egui::vec2(6.0, 0.0);

        // ── Left: label + configuration controls ────────────────────────────
        ui.label(RichText::new(tr("发送区")).strong());
        ui.separator();

        let mut hex = app.settings.send.hex;
        if ui.checkbox(&mut hex, tr("16进制发送")).changed() {
            app.settings.send.hex = hex;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        let mut newline = app.settings.send.append_newline;
        if ui.checkbox(&mut newline, tr("发送新行")).changed() {
            app.settings.send.append_newline = newline;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        if app.settings.send.append_newline {
            let mut cr = app.settings.send.newline_cr;
            let mut lf = app.settings.send.newline_lf;
            let a = ui.checkbox(&mut cr, "CR").changed();
            let b = ui.checkbox(&mut lf, "LF").changed();
            if a || b {
                app.settings.send.newline_cr = cr;
                app.settings.send.newline_lf = lf;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }
        }

        let mut timed = app.settings.send.timed;
        let can_timed = app.link.is_open();
        if ui
            .add_enabled(can_timed, egui::Checkbox::new(&mut timed, tr("定时发送")))
            .changed()
        {
            app.settings.send.timed = timed;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        if app.settings.send.timed {
            let mut period = app.settings.send.period_ms;
            if ui
                .add(
                    egui::DragValue::new(&mut period)
                        .speed(10.0)
                        .range(1..=3_600_000)
                        .suffix(" ms"),
                )
                .changed()
            {
                app.settings.send.period_ms = period;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }
        }

        // ── Right: action buttons, right-to-left, with right padding ────────
        // Reserve RIGHT_PAD on the right edge before placing the 发送 button.
        let avail_w = (ui.available_width() - RIGHT_PAD).max(0.0);
        ui.allocate_ui_with_layout(
            egui::vec2(avail_w, BTN_HEIGHT),
            egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center),
            |ui| {
                ui.spacing_mut().item_spacing = egui::vec2(6.0, 0.0);
                ui.spacing_mut().interact_size.y = BTN_HEIGHT;

                // Rightmost: 发送 (drawn first in right_to_left)
                let send_btn = ui.add_sized(
                    [96.0, BTN_HEIGHT],
                    egui::Button::new(RichText::new(tr("发送 (Ctrl+Enter)")).strong()),
                );
                probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("send", send_btn.rect);
                if send_btn.clicked() {
                    app.send_once();
                }

                // 发送文件 / 终止发送
                let file_button = if app.file_send.is_some() {
                    ui.add_sized([76.0, BTN_HEIGHT], egui::Button::new(tr("终止发送")))
                } else {
                    ui.add_sized([76.0, BTN_HEIGHT], egui::Button::new(tr("发送文件")))
                };
                probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("file", file_button.rect);
                if file_button.clicked() {
                    if app.file_send.is_some() {
                        app.abort_file_send();
                    } else if let Some(path) = pick_open_file(tr("选择要发送的文件")) {
                        app.start_file_send(path);
                    }
                }

                // 清除发送
                let clear_button =
                    ui.add_sized([76.0, BTN_HEIGHT], egui::Button::new(tr("清除发送")));
                probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("clear", clear_button.rect);
                if clear_button.clicked() {
                    app.settings.send.buffer.clear();
                    app.tx_bytes = 0;

/// Lay out only the send editor and report the height it took, so a test can
/// observe that dragging the separator really resizes it.
fn send_area(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
    probe::set_send_panel_rect(ui.max_rect());
    probe::begin_send_toolbar();

    // Toolbar row height: tall enough that text/checkboxes are not clipped.
    const BTN_HEIGHT: f32 = 28.0;
    // Right margin between the 发送 button and the panel edge.
    const RIGHT_PAD: f32 = 6.0;

    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.set_height(BTN_HEIGHT);
        ui.spacing_mut().item_spacing = egui::vec2(6.0, 0.0);

        // ── Left: label + configuration controls ────────────────────────────
        ui.label(RichText::new(tr("发送区")).strong());
        ui.separator();

        let mut hex = app.settings.send.hex;
        if ui.checkbox(&mut hex, tr("16进制发送")).changed() {
            app.settings.send.hex = hex;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        let mut newline = app.settings.send.append_newline;
        if ui.checkbox(&mut newline, tr("发送新行")).changed() {
            app.settings.send.append_newline = newline;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        if app.settings.send.append_newline {
            let mut cr = app.settings.send.newline_cr;
            let mut lf = app.settings.send.newline_lf;
            let a = ui.checkbox(&mut cr, "CR").changed();
            let b = ui.checkbox(&mut lf, "LF").changed();
            if a || b {
                app.settings.send.newline_cr = cr;
                app.settings.send.newline_lf = lf;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }
        }

        let mut timed = app.settings.send.timed;
        let can_timed = app.link.is_open();
        if ui
            .add_enabled(can_timed, egui::Checkbox::new(&mut timed, tr("定时发送")))
            .changed()
        {
            app.settings.send.timed = timed;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        if app.settings.send.timed {
            let mut period = app.settings.send.period_ms;
            if ui
                .add(
                    egui::DragValue::new(&mut period)
                        .speed(10.0)
                        .range(1..=3_600_000)
                        .suffix(" ms"),
                )
                .changed()
            {
                app.settings.send.period_ms = period;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }
        }

        // ── Right: action buttons, right-to-left, with right padding ────────
        // Reserve RIGHT_PAD on the right edge before placing the 发送 button.
        let avail_w = (ui.available_width() - RIGHT_PAD).max(0.0);
        ui.allocate_ui_with_layout(
            egui::vec2(avail_w, BTN_HEIGHT),
            egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center),
            |ui| {
                ui.spacing_mut().item_spacing = egui::vec2(6.0, 0.0);
                ui.spacing_mut().interact_size.y = BTN_HEIGHT;

                // Rightmost: 发送 (drawn first in right_to_left)
                let send_btn = ui.add_sized(
                    [96.0, BTN_HEIGHT],
                    egui::Button::new(RichText::new(tr("发送 (Ctrl+Enter)")).strong()),
                );
                probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("send", send_btn.rect);
                if send_btn.clicked() {
                    app.send_once();
                }

                // 发送文件 / 终止发送
                let file_button = if app.file_send.is_some() {
                    ui.add_sized([76.0, BTN_HEIGHT], egui::Button::new(tr("终止发送")))
                } else {
                    ui.add_sized([76.0, BTN_HEIGHT], egui::Button::new(tr("发送文件")))
                };
                probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("file", file_button.rect);
                if file_button.clicked() {
                    if app.file_send.is_some() {
                        app.abort_file_send();
                    } else if let Some(path) = pick_open_file(tr("选择要发送的文件")) {
                        app.start_file_send(path);
                    }
                }

                // 清除发送
                let clear_button =
                    ui.add_sized([76.0, BTN_HEIGHT], egui::Button::new(tr("清除发送")));
                probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("clear", clear_button.rect);
                if clear_button.clicked() {
                    app.settings.send.buffer.clear();
                    app.tx_bytes = 0;
                    app.rx_bytes = 0;
                    app.mark_settings_dirty();
                    app.info(tr("已清除发送区与收发计数"));
                }

                // 历史 (leftmost of the button group)
                let history = egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("send_history")

pub fn installed_family() -> Option<String> {
    INSTALLED_FAMILY.get().cloned().flatten()
}

fn add_font(fonts: &mut egui::FontDefinitions, key: &str, font: &LoadedFont) {
    let mut data = egui::FontData::from_owned(font.data.clone());
    data.index = font.index;
    fonts.font_data.insert(key.to_owned(), Arc::new(data));
    fonts
        .families
        .entry(egui::FontFamily::Name(Arc::from(key)))
        .or_default()
        .insert(0, key.to_owned());
}

fn bind_font_key(fonts: &mut egui::FontDefinitions, family: egui::FontFamily, key: &str) {
    fonts
        .families
        .entry(family)
        .or_default()
        .insert(0, key.to_owned());
}

fn bind_font_keys(fonts: &mut egui::FontDefinitions, family: egui::FontFamily, keys: &[String]) {
    let list = fonts.families.entry(family).or_default();
    for key in keys {
        list.insert(0, key.clone());
    }
}

fn push_cjk_fallback(fonts: &mut egui::FontDefinitions, family: egui::FontFamily) {
    fonts
        .families
        .entry(family)
        .or_default()
        .push("cjk".to_owned());
}

    match (&receive_custom, &send_custom) {
        // One loaded face can back both named families, avoiding two copies

        (Some(receive), Some(send))

已自行完成 UI 复现、定位、修复和回归验证。

## 问题定位结果

1. **打开串口按钮不居中**
   - 初次红测：按钮中心偏离串口区域中心 `34.50px`
   - 原因：按钮按 `CollapsingHeader` 内缩后的 body 区域布局，而不是按串口设置区域外层矩形居中。

2. **历史下拉框高度低于按钮**
   - 红测：历史框高度 `18px`，发送等按钮高度 `28px`
   - 原因：egui 的 `ComboBox::height()` 控制的是弹出菜单高度，不是按钮高度；按钮高度由 `interact_size.y` 决定。

3. **工具区表头垂直不齐**
   - 建立真实表头布局断言，同时检查中英文混排基线。
   - 原因：ASCII/数字和中文来自不同字体 fallback，各自 font face metrics 不同。

4. **英文/数字高于中文**
   - 红测明确捕获：ASCII 基线 `14.00`，CJK 基线 `15.00`
   - 原因：默认 Latin UI 字体与 CJK fallback 字体不同。
   - 修复后默认 UI 与等宽区域优先选择同一套包含 Latin + CJK 的字体，例如 Noto Sans CJK / Noto Sans Mono CJK，避免混排字体切换。

5. **字体配置**
   - 新增 `FontSettings` 并持久化：
     - 界面字体/字号
     - 接收区字体/字号
     - 发送区字体/字号
   - 在 **显示设置 → 字体设置** 中配置。
   - 接收区与发送区使用独立的 egui named font family，可分别选择系统字体。
   - 旧配置中的 `log_font_size` 会迁移到新的接收区字号。

## 主要修改

- `src/ui/panels.rs`
  - 打开串口按钮按串口区域真实中心布局。
  - 历史下拉框与操作按钮统一为同一高度。
  - 发送区、工具区行高随 UI 字号自适应，避免大字号裁剪。
- `src/fonts.rs`
  - 枚举系统字体。
  - 注册独立的接收/发送字体 family。
  - 默认优先使用 Latin/CJK 同字体方案。
- `src/settings.rs`
  - 新增字体设置、范围校验、JSON 持久化和旧字段迁移。
- `src/app.rs`
  - 字体变更即时应用到 egui context。
  - 增加真实 headless UI 布局回归测试。
- `README.md` / `README_ZH.md`
  - 补充字体配置与混排基线说明。

## 验证

初始红测均已转绿：

- 打开串口按钮水平居中测试通过。
- 历史框高度 `28px`，与发送/清除/发送文件按钮一致。
- 工具区表头中心线一致。
- UI 与等宽字体的 ASCII/CJK 基线差异均小于 `0.01px`。

//! Port discovery, including USB metadata, on a background thread.
//!
//! Enumerating ports touches the OS (on Linux it walks `/sys`, on Windows it
//! queries the setup API), so it must never happen on the UI thread.  A watcher
//! thread polls and only reports the device list when it actually changes,
//! which is also what gives us hot-plug detection for free.

use std::cmp::Ordering;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering as AtomicOrdering};
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::thread::{self, JoinHandle};
use std::time::Duration;

use crossbeam_channel::{unbounded, Receiver, Sender, TryRecvError};
use serialport::SerialPortType;

/// What kind of bus a port sits on.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PortKind {
    Usb {
        vid: u16,
        pid: u16,
        serial: Option<String>,
        manufacturer: Option<String>,
        product: Option<String>,
    },
    Bluetooth,
    Pci,
    Unknown,
}

/// A discovered port plus the metadata the OS was willing to share.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct PortDesc {
    pub name: String,
    pub kind: PortKind,
}

impl PortDesc {
    /// Long description shown in the port list, e.g.
    /// `/dev/ttyUSB0  CH340 (1a86:7523)`.
    pub fn display(&self) -> String {
        match self.detail() {
            Some(detail) => format!("{}  {detail}", self.name),
            None => self.name.clone(),
        }
    }

    /// The metadata portion alone, if any.
    pub fn detail(&self) -> Option<String> {
        match &self.kind {
            PortKind::Usb {
                vid,
                pid,
                serial,
                manufacturer,
                product,
            } => {
                let mut parts: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
                // Prefer a human readable product name over the bare IDs, but
                // keep the IDs because they are what you need for udev rules.
                let mut identity = String::new();
                if let Some(p) = product.as_ref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
                    identity.push_str(p.trim());
                }
                if let Some(m) = manufacturer.as_ref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
                    if identity.is_empty() {
                        identity.push_str(m.trim());
                    } else if !identity.contains(m.trim()) {
                        identity = format!("{} {identity}", m.trim());
                    }
                }
                if !identity.is_empty() {
                    parts.push(identity);
                }
                parts.push(format!("{vid:04x}:{pid:04x}"));
                if let Some(sn) = serial.as_ref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
                    parts.push(format!("SN:{}", sn.trim()));
                }
                Some(parts.join(" "))
            }
            PortKind::Bluetooth => Some(crate::i18n::tr("蓝牙").to_owned()),
            PortKind::Pci => Some("PCI".to_owned()),
            PortKind::Unknown => None,
        }
    }

    /// True when the port looks like a USB serial adapter.
    pub fn is_usb(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self.kind, PortKind::Usb { .. })
    }
}

/// Convert a `serialport` enumeration entry into our description type.
fn convert(info: serialport::SerialPortInfo) -> PortDesc {
    let kind = match info.port_type {
        SerialPortType::UsbPort(usb) => PortKind::Usb {
            vid: usb.vid,
            pid: usb.pid,
            serial: usb.serial_number,
            manufacturer: usb.manufacturer,
            product: usb.product,
        },
        SerialPortType::BluetoothPort => PortKind::Bluetooth,
        SerialPortType::PciPort => PortKind::Pci,
        SerialPortType::Unknown => PortKind::Unknown,
    };
    PortDesc {
        name: info.port_name,
        kind,
    }
}

/// Enumerate ports once, sorted so `ttyUSB2` precedes `ttyUSB10`.
pub fn enumerate() -> Vec<PortDesc> {
    let mut ports: Vec<PortDesc> = match serialport::available_ports() {
        Ok(list) => list.into_iter().map(convert).collect(),
        Err(err) => {
            log::warn!("枚举串口失败: {err}");
            Vec::new()
        }
    };
    ports.sort_by(|a, b| natural_cmp(&a.name, &b.name));
    ports.dedup_by(|a, b| a.name == b.name);
    ports
}

/// Compare two port names treating embedded digit runs as numbers, so that
/// `COM4` sorts before `COM10` instead of after it.
pub fn natural_cmp(a: &str, b: &str) -> Ordering {
    let mut ai = a.chars().peekable();
    let mut bi = b.chars().peekable();
    loop {
        match (ai.peek().copied(), bi.peek().copied()) {
            (None, None) => return Ordering::Equal,
            (None, Some(_)) => return Ordering::Less,
            (Some(_), None) => return Ordering::Greater,
            (Some(ca), Some(cb)) => {
                if ca.is_ascii_digit() && cb.is_ascii_digit() {
                    let na = take_number(&mut ai);
                    let nb = take_number(&mut bi);
                    match na.cmp(&nb) {
                        Ordering::Equal => {}
                        other => return other,
                    }
                } else {
                    match ca.cmp(&cb) {
                        Ordering::Equal => {
                            ai.next();
                            bi.next();
                        }
                        other => return other,
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Consume a run of ASCII digits as an integer.
fn take_number(it: &mut std::iter::Peekable<std::str::Chars<'_>>) -> u64 {
    let mut value: u64 = 0;
    while let Some(&c) = it.peek() {
        match c.to_digit(10) {
            Some(d) => {
                value = value.saturating_mul(10).saturating_add(d as u64);
                it.next();
            }
            None => break,
        }
    }
    value
}

/// Polls the OS and publishes the port list whenever it changes.
pub struct PortWatcher {
    rx: Receiver<Vec<PortDesc>>,
    stop: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    handle: Option<JoinHandle<()>>,
    /// Most recent list, kept for callers that poll faster than the watcher.
    latest: Vec<PortDesc>,
}

impl PortWatcher {
    /// Start watching.  The first list is published immediately.
    pub fn spawn(interval: Duration) -> Self {
        let (tx, rx): (Sender<Vec<PortDesc>>, Receiver<Vec<PortDesc>>) = unbounded();
        let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
        let thread_stop = Arc::clone(&stop);

        let handle = thread::Builder::new()
            .name("port-watcher".to_owned())
            .spawn(move || {
                let mut last: Option<Vec<PortDesc>> = None;
                while !thread_stop.load(AtomicOrdering::Relaxed) {
                    let ports = enumerate();
                    if last.as_ref() != Some(&ports) {
                        if tx.send(ports.clone()).is_err() {
                            break; // Receiver dropped: the app is shutting down.
                        }
                        last = Some(ports);
                    }
                    // Sleep in slices so shutdown is prompt.
                    let mut slept = Duration::ZERO;
                    while slept < interval && !thread_stop.load(AtomicOrdering::Relaxed) {
                        let slice = Duration::from_millis(50).min(interval - slept);
                        thread::sleep(slice);
                        slept += slice;
                    }
                }
            })
            .expect("failed to spawn port watcher thread");

        Self {
            rx,
            stop,
            handle: Some(handle),
            latest: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Latest known port list.
    pub fn ports(&self) -> &[PortDesc] {
        &self.latest
    }

    /// Absorb any pending update.  Returns `true` when the list changed.
    pub fn poll(&mut self) -> bool {
        let mut changed = false;
        loop {
            match self.rx.try_recv() {
                Ok(list) => {
                    self.latest = list;
                    changed = true;
                }
                Err(TryRecvError::Empty) => break,
                Err(TryRecvError::Disconnected) => break,
            }
        }
        changed
    }

    /// Look up a port by device name.
    pub fn find(&self, name: &str) -> Option<&PortDesc> {
        self.latest.iter().find(|p| p.name == name)
    }
}

impl Drop for PortWatcher {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.stop.store(true, AtomicOrdering::Relaxed);
        if let Some(handle) = self.handle.take() {
            let _ = handle.join();
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn natural_sort_orders_numeric_suffixes() {
        let mut names = vec![
            "/dev/ttyUSB10".to_owned(),
            "/dev/ttyUSB2".to_owned(),
            "/dev/ttyUSB1".to_owned(),
            "COM4".to_owned(),
            "COM10".to_owned(),
        ];
        names.sort_by(|a, b| natural_cmp(a, b));
        assert_eq!(
            names,
            vec![
                "/dev/ttyUSB1",
                "/dev/ttyUSB2",
                "/dev/ttyUSB10",
                "COM4",
                "COM10"
            ]

-- send area --
fn send_area(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
    probe::set_send_panel_rect(ui.max_rect());
    probe::begin_send_toolbar();

    // Toolbar row height: tall enough that text/checkboxes are not clipped.
    let btn_height = 28.0_f32.max(
        ui.ctx().fonts_mut(|fonts| {
            fonts.row_height(&egui::FontId::proportional(app.settings.fonts.ui_size))
        }) + 10.0,
    );
    // Right margin between the 发送 button and the panel edge.
    const RIGHT_PAD: f32 = 6.0;

    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.set_height(btn_height);
        ui.spacing_mut().item_spacing = egui::vec2(6.0, 0.0);

        // ── Left: label + configuration controls ────────────────────────────
        ui.label(RichText::new(tr("发送区")).strong());
        ui.separator();

        let mut hex = app.settings.send.hex;
        if ui.checkbox(&mut hex, tr("16进制发送")).changed() {
            app.settings.send.hex = hex;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        let mut newline = app.settings.send.append_newline;
        if ui.checkbox(&mut newline, tr("发送新行")).changed() {
            app.settings.send.append_newline = newline;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        if app.settings.send.append_newline {
            let mut cr = app.settings.send.newline_cr;
            let mut lf = app.settings.send.newline_lf;
            let a = ui.checkbox(&mut cr, "CR").changed();
            let b = ui.checkbox(&mut lf, "LF").changed();
            if a || b {
                app.settings.send.newline_cr = cr;
                app.settings.send.newline_lf = lf;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }
        }

        let mut timed = app.settings.send.timed;
        let can_timed = app.link.is_open();
        if ui
            .add_enabled(can_timed, egui::Checkbox::new(&mut timed, tr("定时发送")))
            .changed()
        {
            app.settings.send.timed = timed;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        if app.settings.send.timed {
            let mut period = app.settings.send.period_ms;
            if ui
                .add(
                    egui::DragValue::new(&mut period)
                        .speed(10.0)
                        .range(1..=3_600_000)
                        .suffix(" ms"),
                )
                .changed()
            {
                app.settings.send.period_ms = period;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }
        }

        // ── Right: action buttons, right-to-left, with right padding ────────
        // Reserve RIGHT_PAD on the right edge before placing the 发送 button.
        let avail_w = (ui.available_width() - RIGHT_PAD).max(0.0);
        ui.allocate_ui_with_layout(
            egui::vec2(avail_w, btn_height),
            egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center),
            |ui| {
                ui.spacing_mut().item_spacing = egui::vec2(6.0, 0.0);
                ui.spacing_mut().interact_size.y = btn_height;

                // Rightmost: 发送 (drawn first in right_to_left)
                let send_btn = ui.add_sized(
                    [96.0, btn_height],
                    egui::Button::new(RichText::new(tr("发送 (Ctrl+Enter)")).strong()),
                );
                probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("send", send_btn.rect);
                if send_btn.clicked() {
                    app.send_once();
                }

                // 发送文件 / 终止发送
                let file_button = if app.file_send.is_some() {
                    ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("终止发送")))
                } else {
                    ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("发送文件")))
                };
                probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("file", file_button.rect);
                if file_button.clicked() {
                    if app.file_send.is_some() {
                        app.abort_file_send();
                    } else if let Some(path) = pick_open_file(tr("选择要发送的文件")) {
                        app.start_file_send(path);
                    }
                }

                // 清除发送
                let clear_button =
                    ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("清除发送")));
                probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("clear", clear_button.rect);
                if clear_button.clicked() {
                    app.settings.send.buffer.clear();
                    app.tx_bytes = 0;
                    app.rx_bytes = 0;
                    app.mark_settings_dirty();
                    app.info(tr("已清除发送区与收发计数"));
                }

                // 历史 (leftmost of the button group)
                let history = egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("send_history")
                    .selected_text(tr("历史"))
                    .width(68.0)
                    .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                        if app.settings.send.history.is_empty() {
                            ui.weak(tr("暂无历史"));
                        }
                        let history = app.settings.send.history.clone();
                        for entry in history {
                            let preview: String = entry.chars().take(40).collect();
                            if ui.selectable_label(false, preview).clicked() {
                                app.settings.send.buffer = entry;
                                app.mark_settings_dirty();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("history", history.response.rect);
            },
        );
    });

    if let Some(send) = app.file_send.as_ref() {
        let progress = send.progress();
        let remaining = send.remaining();
        let name = send.path.clone();
        ui.add(
            egui::ProgressBar::new(progress)
                .text(crate::i18n::tr2("{} · 剩余 {} 字节", name, remaining))
                .desired_height(16.0),
        );
    }

    // Fill whatever height the user has dragged the send area to.  A fixed
    // `desired_rows` left the editor four rows tall no matter how the panel
    // was resized, which reads as "dragging does nothing".
    let available = ui.available_size();
    let editor_size = egui::vec2(available.x, available.y.max(48.0));
    let editor = ui.add(
        egui::TextEdit::multiline(&mut app.settings.send.buffer)
            .font(crate::fonts::send_font_id(app.settings.fonts.send_size))
            .desired_width(editor_size.x)
            .min_size(editor_size)
            .hint_text(if app.settings.send.hex {
                tr("输入十六进制，如 01 02 0A（可省略空格）")
            } else {
                tr("输入要发送的内容")
            }),
    );
    probe::set_editor_rect(editor.rect);
}

// Right: multi-send and protocol pages
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// `predicted_dt`, which would overtake a fixed value.
    fn input() -> egui::RawInput {
        egui::RawInput {
            screen_rect: Some(egui::Rect::from_min_size(
                egui::Pos2::ZERO,
                egui::vec2(1280.0, 840.0),
            )),
            time: Some(next_time()),
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    /// Lay out two frames and assert the result is not empty.
    ///
    /// Two passes matter: the first populates panel state (scroll areas, grid
    /// widths) and the second re-reads it, which is where sizing bugs show up.
    fn render(app: &mut XcomApp, ctx: &egui::Context, what: &str) {
        if app.applied_fonts.is_none() {
            crate::fonts::install_default_families(ctx);
        }
        for pass in 0..2 {
            let mut output = ctx.run_ui(input(), |ui| app.draw(ui));
            let shapes = output.shapes.len();
            // A real renderer applies these; the test only cares that the frame
            // laid out, so discard them explicitly rather than leaking.
            output.textures_delta.clear();
            assert!(shapes > 0, "{what}: pass {pass} produced no shapes");
        }
    }

    fn seeded() -> XcomApp {
        let mut app = XcomApp::headless(crate::settings::Settings::default());
        app.log
            .append("AT+GMR\r\nOK\r\n温度: 25.6C\r\n".as_bytes(), 0);
        app.rx_bytes = 31;
        app.tx_bytes = 8;
        app.settings.send.buffer = "AT".to_owned();
        app.settings.send.history = vec!["AT".to_owned(), "AT+RST".to_owned()];
        app.settings.serial.port = "/dev/ttyUSB0".to_owned();
        app
    }

    /// A frame with an optional pointer press at `pos`.
    fn pointer(pos: egui::Pos2, pressed: Option<bool>) -> egui::RawInput {
        let mut raw = input();
        raw.events.push(egui::Event::PointerMoved(pos));
        if let Some(pressed) = pressed {
            raw.events.push(egui::Event::PointerButton {
                pos,
                button: egui::PointerButton::Primary,
                pressed,
                modifiers: Default::default(),
            });
        }
        raw
    }

    /// Lay out every real panel for one frame, returning the centre column.
    fn full_frame(ctx: &egui::Context, app: &mut XcomApp, raw: egui::RawInput) -> egui::Rect {
        crate::fonts::install_default_families(ctx);
        let slot = std::cell::Cell::new(egui::Rect::NOTHING);
        let mut output = ctx.run_ui(raw, |ui| {
            panels::top_bar(app, ui);
            panels::status_bar(app, ui);
            panels::left_panel(app, ui);
            if app.show_side_panel {
                panels::side_panel(app, ui);
            }
            slot.set(ui.available_rect_before_wrap());
            panels::center_panel(app, ui);
            // Mirrors `draw`: the splitters are registered after every panel.
            panels::apply_splitters(app, ui);
        });
        output.textures_delta.clear();
        slot.get()
    }

    /// Press at `from`, drag to `to`, release.  Every frame lays out the real
    /// panels, which is required: a panel that is not laid out never registers
    /// its resize handle, so there would be nothing to grab.
    /// A monotonically increasing frame time.
    ///
    /// egui panics if time goes backwards, so every drag in a test must
    /// continue from where the previous one stopped rather than restarting.
    fn next_time() -> f64 {
        thread_local! {
            static TIME: std::cell::Cell<f64> = const { std::cell::Cell::new(1000.0) };
        }
        TIME.with(|t| {
            let next = t.get() + 0.02;
            t.set(next);
            next
        })
    }

    fn drag(ctx: &egui::Context, app: &mut XcomApp, from: egui::Pos2, to: egui::Pos2) {
        let positions = [from, from, to, to, to];
        let presses = [None, Some(true), None, None, Some(false)];
        for (position, pressed) in positions.into_iter().zip(presses) {
            full_frame(ctx, app, pointer(position, pressed));
        }
    }

    fn open_port_button_is_horizontally_centered() {
        let ctx = egui::Context::default();

        let button = panels::probe::open_button_rect();
        assert!(content.width() > 0.0, "serial content was not laid out");
        assert!(button.width() > 0.0, "open button was not laid out");
        let offset = (button.center().x - content.center().x).abs();
        assert!(
            offset <= 0.75,
            "open button is {offset:.2}px from the serial section centre"
        );
    }

impl PortDesc {
    /// Compact label shown in the port list, e.g. `/dev/ttyUSB0 (CH340)`.
    pub fn display(&self) -> String {
        match &self.kind {
            PortKind::Usb {
                product,
                manufacturer,
                ..
            } => {
                let identity = product
                    .as_deref()
                    .map(str::trim)
                    .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
                    .or_else(|| {
                        manufacturer
                            .as_deref()
                            .map(str::trim)
                            .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
                    });
                identity.map_or_else(
                    || self.name.clone(),
                    |identity| format!("{} ({identity})", self.name),
                )
            }
            PortKind::Bluetooth => format!("{} ({})", self.name, crate::i18n::tr("蓝牙")),
            PortKind::Pci => format!("{} (PCI)", self.name),
            PortKind::Unknown => self.name.clone(),
        }

/// Lay out only the send editor and report the height it took, so a test can
/// observe that dragging the separator really resizes it.
fn send_area(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
    probe::set_send_panel_rect(ui.max_rect());
    probe::begin_send_toolbar();

    // Toolbar row height: tall enough that text/checkboxes are not clipped.
    let btn_height = 28.0_f32.max(
        ui.ctx().fonts_mut(|fonts| {
            fonts.row_height(&egui::FontId::proportional(app.settings.fonts.ui_size))
        }) + 10.0,
    );
    // Right margin between the 发送 button and the panel edge.
    const RIGHT_PAD: f32 = 6.0;

    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.set_height(btn_height);
        ui.spacing_mut().item_spacing = egui::vec2(6.0, 0.0);

        // ── Left: label + configuration controls ────────────────────────────
        let section_label = ui.label(RichText::new(tr("发送区")).strong());
        probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("section", section_label.rect);
        ui.separator();

        let mut hex = app.settings.send.hex;
        let hex_control = ui.checkbox(&mut hex, tr("16进制发送"));
        probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("hex", hex_control.rect);
        if hex_control.changed() {
            app.settings.send.hex = hex;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        let mut newline = app.settings.send.append_newline;
        let newline_control = ui.checkbox(&mut newline, tr("发送新行"));
        probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("newline", newline_control.rect);
        if newline_control.changed() {
            app.settings.send.append_newline = newline;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        if app.settings.send.append_newline {
            let mut cr = app.settings.send.newline_cr;
            let mut lf = app.settings.send.newline_lf;
            let a = ui.checkbox(&mut cr, "CR").changed();
            let b = ui.checkbox(&mut lf, "LF").changed();
            if a || b {
                app.settings.send.newline_cr = cr;
                app.settings.send.newline_lf = lf;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }
        }

        let mut timed = app.settings.send.timed;
        let can_timed = app.link.is_open();
        if ui
            .add_enabled(can_timed, egui::Checkbox::new(&mut timed, tr("定时发送")))
            .changed()
        {
            app.settings.send.timed = timed;
            app.mark_settings_dirty();
        }
        if app.settings.send.timed {
            let mut period = app.settings.send.period_ms;
            if ui
                .add(
                    egui::DragValue::new(&mut period)
                        .speed(10.0)
                        .range(1..=3_600_000)
                        .suffix(" ms"),
                )
                .changed()
            {
                app.settings.send.period_ms = period;
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }
        }

        // ── Right: action buttons, right-to-left, with right padding ────────
        // Reserve RIGHT_PAD on the right edge before placing the 发送 button.
        let avail_w = (ui.available_width() - RIGHT_PAD).max(0.0);
        ui.allocate_ui_with_layout(
            egui::vec2(avail_w, btn_height),
            egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center),
            |ui| {
                ui.spacing_mut().item_spacing = egui::vec2(6.0, 0.0);
                ui.spacing_mut().interact_size.y = btn_height;

                // Rightmost: 发送 (drawn first in right_to_left)
                let send_btn = ui.add_sized(
                    [96.0, btn_height],
                    egui::Button::new(RichText::new(tr("发送 (Ctrl+Enter)")).strong()),
                );
                probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("send", send_btn.rect);
                if send_btn.clicked() {
                    app.send_once();
                }

                // 发送文件 / 终止发送
                let file_button = if app.file_send.is_some() {
                    ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("终止发送")))
                } else {
                    ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("发送文件")))
                };
                probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("file", file_button.rect);
                if file_button.clicked() {
                    if app.file_send.is_some() {
                        app.abort_file_send();
                    } else if let Some(path) = pick_open_file(tr("选择要发送的文件")) {
                        app.start_file_send(path);
                    }
                }

                // 清除发送
                let clear_button =
                    ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("清除发送")));
                probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("clear", clear_button.rect);
                if clear_button.clicked() {
                    app.settings.send.buffer.clear();
                    app.tx_bytes = 0;
                    app.rx_bytes = 0;
                    app.mark_settings_dirty();
                    app.info(tr("已清除发送区与收发计数"));
                }

                // 历史 (leftmost of the button group)
                let history = egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("send_history")
                    .selected_text(tr("历史"))
                    .width(68.0)
                    .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                        if app.settings.send.history.is_empty() {
                            ui.weak(tr("暂无历史"));
                        }
                        let history = app.settings.send.history.clone();
                        for entry in history {
                            let preview: String = entry.chars().take(40).collect();
                            if ui.selectable_label(false, preview).clicked() {
                                app.settings.send.buffer = entry;
                                app.mark_settings_dirty();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("history", history.response.rect);

        egui::Button::new(RichText::new(tr("发送 (Ctrl+Enter)")).strong()),
    );
    probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("send", send_btn.rect);
    if send_btn.clicked() {
        app.send_once();
    }

    // 发送文件 / 终止发送
    let file_button = if app.file_send.is_some() {
        ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("终止发送")))
    } else {
        ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("发送文件")))
    };
    probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("file", file_button.rect);
    if file_button.clicked() {
        if app.file_send.is_some() {
            app.abort_file_send();
        } else if let Some(path) = pick_open_file(tr("选择要发送的文件")) {
            app.start_file_send(path);
        }
    }

    // 清除发送
    let clear_button = ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("清除发送")));
    probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("clear", clear_button.rect);
    if clear_button.clicked() {
        app.settings.send.buffer.clear();
        app.tx_bytes = 0;
        app.rx_bytes = 0;
        app.mark_settings_dirty();
        app.info(tr("已清除发送区与收发计数"));
    }

    // 历史 (leftmost of the button group)
    let history = egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("send_history")
        .selected_text(tr("历史"))
        .width(68.0)
        .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
            if app.settings.send.history.is_empty() {
                ui.weak(tr("暂无历史"));
            }
            let history = app.settings.send.history.clone();
            for entry in history {
                let preview: String = entry.chars().take(40).collect();
                if ui.selectable_label(false, preview).clicked() {
                    app.settings.send.buffer = entry;
                    app.mark_settings_dirty();
                }
            }
        });
    probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("history", history.response.rect);
}

fn right_aligned_send_actions(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui, btn_height: f32) {
    let avail_w = (ui.available_width() - SEND_RIGHT_PAD).max(0.0);
    ui.allocate_ui_with_layout(
        egui::vec2(avail_w, btn_height),
        egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center),
        |ui| send_actions(app, ui, btn_height),
    );
}

        ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("终止发送")))
    } else {
        ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("发送文件")))
    };
    probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("file", file_button.rect);
    if file_button.clicked() {
        if app.file_send.is_some() {
            app.abort_file_send();
        } else if let Some(path) = pick_open_file(tr("选择要发送的文件")) {
            app.start_file_send(path);
        }
    }

    // 清除发送
    let clear_button = ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("清除发送")));
    probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("clear", clear_button.rect);
    if clear_button.clicked() {
        app.settings.send.buffer.clear();
        app.tx_bytes = 0;
        app.rx_bytes = 0;
        app.mark_settings_dirty();
        app.info(tr("已清除发送区与收发计数"));
    }

    // 历史 (leftmost of the button group)
    let history = egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("send_history")
        .selected_text(tr("历史"))
        .width(68.0)
        .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
            if app.settings.send.history.is_empty() {

            }
            let history = app.settings.send.history.clone();

                if ui.selectable_label(false, preview).clicked() {
                    app.settings.send.buffer = entry;
                    app.mark_settings_dirty();
                }
            }
        });
    probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("history", history.response.rect);
}

+fn send_actions(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui, btn_height: f32) {
+    ui.spacing_mut().item_spacing = egui::vec2(6.0, 0.0);
+    ui.spacing_mut().interact_size.y = btn_height;
+
+    // Rightmost: 发送 (drawn first in right_to_left)
+    let send_btn = ui.add_sized(
+        [96.0, btn_height],
+        egui::Button::new(RichText::new(tr("发送 (Ctrl+Enter)")).strong()),
+    );
+    probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("send", send_btn.rect);
+    if send_btn.clicked() {
+        app.send_once();
+    }
+
+    // 发送文件 / 终止发送
+    let file_button = if app.file_send.is_some() {
+        ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("终止发送")))
+    } else {
+        ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("发送文件")))
+    };
+    probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("file", file_button.rect);
+    if file_button.clicked() {
+        if app.file_send.is_some() {
+            app.abort_file_send();
+        } else if let Some(path) = pick_open_file(tr("选择要发送的文件")) {
+            app.start_file_send(path);
+        }
+    }
+
+    // 清除发送
+    let clear_button = ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("清除发送")));
+    probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("clear", clear_button.rect);
+    if clear_button.clicked() {
+        app.settings.send.buffer.clear();
+        app.tx_bytes = 0;
+        app.rx_bytes = 0;
+        app.mark_settings_dirty();
+        app.info(tr("已清除发送区与收发计数"));
+    }
+
+    // 历史 (leftmost of the button group)
+    let history = egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("send_history")
+        .selected_text(tr("历史"))
+        .width(68.0)
+        .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
+            if app.settings.send.history.is_empty() {
+                ui.weak(tr("暂无历史"));
+            }
+            let history = app.settings.send.history.clone();
+            for entry in history {
+                let preview: String = entry.chars().take(40).collect();
+                if ui.selectable_label(false, preview).clicked() {
+                    app.settings.send.buffer = entry;
+                    app.mark_settings_dirty();
+                }
+            }
+        });
+    probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("history", history.response.rect);
+}
+
+fn right_aligned_send_actions(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui, btn_height: f32) {
+    let avail_w = (ui.available_width() - SEND_RIGHT_PAD).max(0.0);
+    ui.allocate_ui_with_layout(
+        egui::vec2(avail_w, btn_height),
+        egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center),
+        |ui| send_actions(app, ui, btn_height),
+    );
+}

## 1. 发送区域控件重叠

### 红测结果

在真实 headless egui 布局中使用最小窗口 `880×540` 复现：

```text
section overlapped history:
[288.0 322.5] - [328.1 337.5]
vs
[249.6 316.0] - [317.6 344.0]
```

确认“发送区”标签与“历史”下拉框实际相交。

### 原因

发送区把左侧配置项和右侧固定宽度操作组强行放在同一行。窗口较窄且左右工具面板都显示时，中央区域不足以容纳两组控件；`right_to_left` 子布局继续向左绘制，导致覆盖左侧控件。

### 修复

- 将发送操作按钮抽取为独立布局函数。
- 宽度足够时保持单行右对齐。
- 宽度不足时自动把“历史 / 清除发送 / 发送文件 / 发送”放到第二行，并保持右对齐。
- 阈值随 UI 字号放大，避免大字号下仍重叠。

新增回归测试：

```text
send_toolbar_does_not_overlap_at_minimum_window_width
```

现已通过。

+fn send_actions(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui, btn_height: f32) {
+    ui.spacing_mut().item_spacing = egui::vec2(6.0, 0.0);
+    ui.spacing_mut().interact_size.y = btn_height;
+
+    // Rightmost: 发送 (drawn first in right_to_left)
+    let send_btn = ui.add_sized(

+        egui::Button::new(RichText::new(tr("发送 (Ctrl+Enter)")).strong()),
+    );
+    probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("send", send_btn.rect);
+    if send_btn.clicked() {
+        app.send_once();
+    }
+
+    // 发送文件 / 终止发送
+    let file_button = if app.file_send.is_some() {
+        ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("终止发送")))
+    } else {
+        ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("发送文件")))
+    };
+    probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("file", file_button.rect);
+    if file_button.clicked() {
+        if app.file_send.is_some() {
+            app.abort_file_send();
+        } else if let Some(path) = pick_open_file(tr("选择要发送的文件")) {
+            app.start_file_send(path);
+        }
+    }
+
+    // 清除发送
+    let clear_button = ui.add_sized([76.0, btn_height], egui::Button::new(tr("清除发送")));
+    probe::push_send_toolbar_rect("clear", clear_button.rect);
+    if clear_button.clicked() {
+        app.settings.send.buffer.clear();
+        app.tx_bytes = 0;
+        app.rx_bytes = 0;
+        app.mark_settings_dirty();
+        app.info(tr("已清除发送区与收发计数"));

+
+    // 历史 (leftmost of the button group)

+        .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
+            if app.settings.send.history.is_empty() {

fn serial_section(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
    let open = app.link.is_open();
    let serial_bounds = ui.max_rect();
    probe::set_serial_content_rect(serial_bounds);
    egui::CollapsingHeader::new(tr("串口设置"))
        .default_open(true)
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            egui::Grid::new("serial_grid")
                .num_columns(2)
                .spacing([8.0, 6.0])
                .show(ui, |ui| {
                    ui.label(tr("串口"));
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        let ports = app.ports.ports().to_vec();
                        let current = app.settings.serial.port.clone();
                        let selected_text = ports
                            .iter()
                            .find(|p| p.name == current)
                            .map(|p| p.display())
                            .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                                if current.is_empty() {
                                    tr("（无可用串口）").to_owned()
                                } else {
                                    current.clone()
                                }
                            });
                        let port_combo_width = (ui.available_width() - 66.0).max(96.0);
                        ui.add_enabled_ui(!open, |ui| {
                            egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("port_select")
                                .selected_text(selected_text)
                                .width(port_combo_width)
                                .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                                    if ports.is_empty() {
                                        ui.weak(tr("未检测到串口"));
                                    }
                                    for port in &ports {
                                        let item = ui.selectable_label(
                                            port.name == app.settings.serial.port,
                                            port.display(),
                                        );
                                        let item = item.on_hover_text(
                                            port.detail().unwrap_or_else(|| port.display()),
                                        );
                                        if item.clicked() {
                                            app.settings.serial.port = port.name.clone();
                                            app.mark_settings_dirty();
                                        }
                                    }
                                });
                        });
                        if ui
                            .add_enabled(!open, egui::Button::new(tr("刷新")))
                            .clicked()
                        {
                            app.ports.poll();
                            app.info(tr("已刷新串口列表"));
                        }
                    });
                    ui.end_row();

    #[test]
    fn usb_port_label_stays_compact() {
        let desc = PortDesc {
            name: "/dev/ttyUSB0".to_owned(),
            kind: PortKind::Usb {
                vid: 0x0403,
                pid: 0x6001,
                serial: Some("FTDI-123456".to_owned()),
                manufacturer: Some("FTDI".to_owned()),
                product: Some("FT232R USB UART".to_owned()),
            },
        };

        assert_eq!(desc.display(), "/dev/ttyUSB0 (FT232R USB UART)");
        let tooltip = desc.detail().unwrap();
        assert!(tooltip.contains("0403:6001"), "{tooltip}");
        assert!(tooltip.contains("SN:FTDI-123456"), "{tooltip}");
    }

            tooltip.lines().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            vec![
                "Product: FT232R USB UART",
                "Manufacturer: FTDI",
                "PID/VID: 0403:6001",
                "SN: FTDI-123456",
            ],
            "{tooltip}"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn detail_survives_missing_metadata() {
        let desc = PortDesc {
            name: "/dev/ttyS0".to_owned(),
            kind: PortKind::Unknown,
        };
        assert_eq!(desc.detail(), None);
        assert_eq!(desc.display(), "/dev/ttyS0");
        assert!(!desc.is_usb());
    }
}

## 1. 英文下 Refresh 按钮被遮盖

### 红测结果

在英文界面、左面板最小宽度下复现：

```text
Refresh button: [217.7, 46.0] - [270.7, 64.0]
Serial content: [8.0, 25.0] - [223.0, 815.0]
```

按钮右边界超出串口内容区域约 `47.7px`。

### 原因

串口行原来使用不可换行的 `ui.horizontal`。英文 `Refresh` 比中文“刷新”宽，下拉框最小宽度加上按钮后超出 Grid 单元格，被内容裁剪区域遮住。

### 修复

- 串口行改为 `ui.horizontal_wrapped`。
- 宽度足够时保持原布局。
- 宽度不足时 Refresh 自动换到下一行，确保完整显示且不越界。

fn serial_section(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
    let open = app.link.is_open();
    let serial_bounds = ui.max_rect();
    probe::set_serial_content_rect(serial_bounds);
    egui::CollapsingHeader::new(tr("串口设置"))
        .default_open(true)
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            egui::Grid::new("serial_grid")
                .num_columns(2)
                .spacing([8.0, 6.0])
                .show(ui, |ui| {
                    ui.label(tr("串口"));
                    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
                        let ports = app.ports.ports().to_vec();
                        let current = app.settings.serial.port.clone();
                        let selected_text = ports
                            .iter()
                            .find(|p| p.name == current)
                            .map(|p| p.display())
                            .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                                if current.is_empty() {
                                    tr("（无可用串口）").to_owned()
                                } else {
                                    current.clone()
                                }
                            });
                        let port_combo_width = (ui.available_width() - 66.0).max(96.0);
                        ui.add_enabled_ui(!open, |ui| {
                            egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("port_select")
                                .selected_text(selected_text)
                                .width(port_combo_width)
                                .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                                    if ports.is_empty() {
                                        ui.weak(tr("未检测到串口"));
                                    }
                                    for port in &ports {
                                        let item = ui.selectable_label(
                                            port.name == app.settings.serial.port,
                                            port.display(),
                                        );
                                        let item = item.on_hover_text(
                                            port.detail().unwrap_or_else(|| port.display()),
                                        );
                                        if item.clicked() {
                                            app.settings.serial.port = port.name.clone();
                                            app.mark_settings_dirty();
                                        }
                                    }
                                });
                        });
                        let refresh = ui.add_enabled(!open, egui::Button::new(tr("刷新")));
                        probe::set_refresh_button_rect(refresh.rect);
                        if refresh.clicked() {

fn combo_box_dyn<'c, R>(
    ui: &mut Ui,
    button_id: Id,
    selected_text: WidgetText,
    menu_contents: Box<dyn FnOnce(&mut Ui) -> R + 'c>,
    icon: Option<IconPainter>,

    close_behavior: Option<PopupCloseBehavior>,
    popup_style: StyleModifier,
    (width, height): (Option<f32>, Option<f32>),
) -> InnerResponse<Option<R>> {
    let popup_id = ComboBox::widget_to_popup_id(button_id);

    let is_popup_open = Popup::is_id_open(ui.ctx(), popup_id);

    let wrap_mode = wrap_mode.unwrap_or_else(|| ui.wrap_mode());

    let close_behavior = close_behavior.unwrap_or(PopupCloseBehavior::CloseOnClick);

    let margin = ui.spacing().button_padding;
    let button_response = button_frame(ui, button_id, is_popup_open, Sense::click(), |ui| {
        let icon_spacing = ui.spacing().icon_spacing;
        let icon_size = Vec2::splat(ui.spacing().icon_width);

        // The combo box selected text will always have this minimum width.
        // Note: the `ComboBox::width()` if set or `Spacing::combo_width` are considered as the
        // minimum overall width, regardless of the wrap mode.
        let minimum_width = width.unwrap_or_else(|| ui.spacing().combo_width) - 2.0 * margin.x;

        // width against which to lay out the selected text
        let wrap_width = if wrap_mode == TextWrapMode::Extend {
            // Use all the width necessary to display the currently selected value's text.
            f32::INFINITY
        } else {
            // Use the available width, currently selected value's text will be wrapped if exceeds this value.
            ui.available_width() - icon_spacing - icon_size.x
        };

        let galley = selected_text.into_galley(ui, Some(wrap_mode), wrap_width, TextStyle::Button);

        let actual_width = (galley.size().x + icon_spacing + icon_size.x).at_least(minimum_width);
        let actual_height = galley.size().y.max(icon_size.y);

        let (_, rect) = ui.allocate_space(Vec2::new(actual_width, actual_height));
        let button_rect = ui.min_rect().expand2(ui.spacing().button_padding);

                &ui.visuals().widgets.open
            } else {
                ui.style().interact(&response)
            };

                    icon_rect.expand(visuals.expansion),

                );

                paint_default_icon(ui.painter(), icon_rect.expand(visuals.expansion), visuals);
            }

            let text_rect = Align2::LEFT_CENTER.align_size_within_rect(galley.size(), rect);
            ui.painter()
                .galley(text_rect.min, galley, visuals.text_color());
        }
    });

# Project AGENTS.md

## Coding Guidelines

Based on [Andrej Karpathy's guidelines](https://x.com/karpathy/status/2015883857489522876) for reducing common LLM coding mistakes:

### 1. Think Before Coding

**Don't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.**

Before implementing:
- State your assumptions explicitly. If uncertain, ask.
- If multiple interpretations exist, present them - don't pick silently.
- If a simpler approach exists, say so. Push back when warranted.
- If something is unclear, stop. Name what's confusing. Ask.

### 2. Simplicity First

**Minimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.**

- No features beyond what was asked.
- No abstractions for single-use code.
- No "flexibility" or "configurability" that wasn't requested.
- No error handling for impossible scenarios.
- If you write 200 lines and it could be 50, rewrite it.

Ask yourself: "Would a senior engineer say this is overcomplicated?" If yes, simplify.

### 3. Surgical Changes

**Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.**

When editing existing code:
- Don't "improve" adjacent code, comments, or formatting.
- Don't refactor things that aren't broken.
- Match existing style, even if you'd do it differently.
- If you notice unrelated dead code, mention it - don't delete it.

When your changes create orphans:
- Remove imports/variables/functions that YOUR changes made unused.
- Don't remove pre-existing dead code unless asked.

The test: Every changed line should trace directly to the user's request.

### 4. Goal-Driven Execution

**Define success criteria. Loop until verified.**

Transform tasks into verifiable goals:
- "Add validation" → "Write tests for invalid inputs, then make them pass"
- "Fix the bug" → "Write a test that reproduces it, then make it pass"
- "Refactor X" → "Ensure tests pass before and after"

For multi-step tasks, state a brief plan:
```
1. [Step] → verify: [check]
2. [Step] → verify: [check]
3. [Step] → verify: [check]
```

Strong success criteria let you loop independently. Weak criteria ("make it work") require constant clarification.

---

## Tradeoff Note

These guidelines bias toward caution over speed. For trivial tasks, use judgment.

///
/// egui's own panel resizing is not used here.  Its `default_size` is
/// order-dependent against `min_size`/`max_size`, so a panel configured the
/// obvious way silently falls back to its minimum, and the resulting width ends
/// up driven by the panel's *content* -- which made the settings panel ignore
/// attempts to shrink it, and made the tool panel snap back in the English UI
/// where the translated labels are wider.  Owning the number makes the
/// behaviour obvious and testable; it is persisted with the rest of the
/// settings.
///
/// Register every pending splitter.  Returns nothing; drags are written
/// straight back into the settings.
pub(crate) fn apply_splitters(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
    for spec in std::mem::take(&mut app.pending_splitters) {
        const GRAB: f32 = 6.0;
        let rect = spec.growth.band(spec.boundary, spec.cross, GRAB);
        let response = ui.interact(
            rect,
            egui::Id::new(("splitter", spec.id)),
            egui::Sense::click_and_drag(),
        );
        if response.hovered() || response.dragged() {
            ui.ctx().set_cursor_icon(spec.growth.cursor());
        }

        // The size is tracked as a delta from where the drag started, not as an
        // absolute distance from a fixed edge.  The edge moves as the panel
        // resizes, so an absolute reading is recomputed differently on every
        // frame of the gesture -- the panel overshoots and then creeps back.
        let state_id = egui::Id::new(("splitter-drag", spec.id));
        let current = spec.current_size;

        // Record the origin when the button goes down, not when egui decides a
        // drag has begun: the threshold means those are different frames, and
        // using the later one would make the first delta zero.
        if response.is_pointer_button_down_on()
            && ui.data(|data| data.get_temp::<(f32, egui::Pos2)>(state_id).is_none())
            && let Some(pointer) = response.interact_pointer_pos()
        {
            ui.data_mut(|data| data.insert_temp(state_id, (current, pointer)));
        }

        if response.dragged() {
            let origin = ui.data(|data| data.get_temp::<(f32, egui::Pos2)>(state_id));
            if let (Some((start_size, start_pointer)), Some(pointer)) =
                (origin, response.interact_pointer_pos())
            {
                let size = (start_size + spec.growth.growth_delta(pointer, start_pointer))
                    .clamp(spec.min, spec.max);
                match spec.target {
                    SplitterTarget::LeftWidth => app.settings.left_panel_width = size,
                    SplitterTarget::RightWidth => app.settings.right_panel_width = size,
                    SplitterTarget::SendHeight => app.settings.send_area_height = size,
                }
                app.mark_settings_dirty();
            }
        }

        if response.drag_stopped() || !response.is_pointer_button_down_on() {
            ui.data_mut(|data| data.remove::<(f32, egui::Pos2)>(state_id));
        }
    }
}

//! Serial port configuration model and its mapping onto the OS driver.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serialport::{DataBits, FlowControl, Parity, StopBits};

/// Number of data bits per character.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum DataBitsSel {
    Five,
    Six,
    Seven,
    Eight,
}

impl DataBitsSel {
    pub const ALL: [DataBitsSel; 4] = [
        DataBitsSel::Five,
        DataBitsSel::Six,
        DataBitsSel::Seven,
        DataBitsSel::Eight,
    ];

    pub fn label(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            DataBitsSel::Five => "5",
            DataBitsSel::Six => "6",
            DataBitsSel::Seven => "7",
            DataBitsSel::Eight => "8",
        }
    }

    pub fn bits(self) -> u8 {
        match self {
            DataBitsSel::Five => 5,
            DataBitsSel::Six => 6,
            DataBitsSel::Seven => 7,
            DataBitsSel::Eight => 8,
        }
    }

    fn to_driver(self) -> DataBits {
        match self {
            DataBitsSel::Five => DataBits::Five,
            DataBitsSel::Six => DataBits::Six,
            DataBitsSel::Seven => DataBits::Seven,
            DataBitsSel::Eight => DataBits::Eight,
        }
    }
}

/// Number of stop bits.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum StopBitsSel {
    One,
    OnePointFive,
    Two,
}

impl StopBitsSel {
    pub const ALL: [StopBitsSel; 3] = [
        StopBitsSel::One,
        StopBitsSel::OnePointFive,
        StopBitsSel::Two,
    ];

    pub fn label(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            StopBitsSel::One => "1",
            StopBitsSel::OnePointFive => "1.5",
            StopBitsSel::Two => "2",
        }
    }
}

/// Parity checking mode.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum ParitySel {
    None,
    Odd,
    Even,
}

impl ParitySel {
    pub const ALL: [ParitySel; 3] = [ParitySel::None, ParitySel::Odd, ParitySel::Even];

    pub fn label(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            ParitySel::None => "无",
            ParitySel::Odd => "奇校验",
            ParitySel::Even => "偶校验",
        }
    }

    fn to_driver(self) -> Parity {
        match self {
            ParitySel::None => Parity::None,
            ParitySel::Odd => Parity::Odd,
            ParitySel::Even => Parity::Even,
        }
    }
}

/// Hardware/software flow control.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum FlowSel {
    None,
    Software,
    Hardware,
}

impl FlowSel {
    pub const ALL: [FlowSel; 3] = [FlowSel::None, FlowSel::Software, FlowSel::Hardware];

    pub fn label(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            FlowSel::None => "无",
            FlowSel::Software => "软件 (XON/XOFF)",
            FlowSel::Hardware => "硬件 (RTS/CTS)",
        }
    }

    fn to_driver(self) -> FlowControl {
        match self {
            FlowSel::None => FlowControl::None,
            FlowSel::Software => FlowControl::Software,
            FlowSel::Hardware => FlowControl::Hardware,
        }
    }
}

/// Standard baud rates offered in the drop-down, matching the original tool
/// plus a few modern additions.
pub const STANDARD_BAUDS: [u32; 20] = [
    1200, 2400, 4800, 9600, 14400, 19200, 38400, 56000, 57600, 115200, 128000, 230400, 256000,
    460800, 500000, 512000, 600000, 921600, 1000000, 1382400,
];

/// Lowest/highest baud rate accepted for a custom value.
pub const CUSTOM_BAUD_RANGE: (u32, u32) = (50, 12_000_000);

/// Everything needed to open a port.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(default)]
pub struct SerialConfig {
    /// Port device path, e.g. `/dev/ttyUSB0` or `COM3`.
    pub port: String,
    pub baud: u32,
    pub data_bits: DataBitsSel,
    pub stop_bits: StopBitsSel,
    pub parity: ParitySel,
    pub flow: FlowSel,
    /// Assert DTR when the port opens.
    pub dtr: bool,
    /// Assert RTS when the port opens.
    pub rts: bool,
}

impl Default for SerialConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            port: String::new(),
            baud: 115200,
            data_bits: DataBitsSel::Eight,
            stop_bits: StopBitsSel::One,
            parity: ParitySel::None,
            flow: FlowSel::None,
            dtr: true,
            rts: true,
        }
    }
}

/// A concrete, driver-level description of how to open a port.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct OpenPlan {
    pub baud: u32,
    pub data_bits: DataBits,
    pub stop_bits: StopBits,
    pub parity: Parity,
    pub flow: FlowControl,
    /// Non-fatal caveat worth surfacing to the user in the log.
    pub note: Option<String>,
}

impl SerialConfig {
    /// A one-line summary such as `115200 8-N-1`.
    pub fn summary(&self) -> String {
        let parity = match self.parity {
            ParitySel::None => "N",
            ParitySel::Odd => "O",
            ParitySel::Even => "E",
        };
        let stop = match self.stop_bits {
            StopBitsSel::One => "1",
            StopBitsSel::OnePointFive => "1.5",
            StopBitsSel::Two => "2",
        };
        format!("{}-{}{}{}", self.baud, self.data_bits.bits(), parity, stop)
    }

    /// Translate the user's selection into driver settings.
    ///
    /// 1.5 stop bits deserves a word of explanation.  POSIX termios (Linux and
    /// macOS) has no dedicated flag for it: the *only* way to request 1.5 stop
    /// bits is `CSTOPB` together with 5 data bits, which is what the kernel
    /// interprets as 1.5 rather than 2.  Windows, by contrast, has a real
    /// `ONE5STOPBITS` DCB value, but the `serialport` crate does not expose it.
    /// Rather than silently pretending, we report exactly what happened.
    pub fn to_plan(&self) -> OpenPlan {
        let mut note = None;

        let stop_bits = match self.stop_bits {
            StopBitsSel::One => StopBits::One,
            StopBitsSel::Two => StopBits::Two,
            StopBitsSel::OnePointFive => {
                if cfg!(target_os = "linux") && self.data_bits == DataBitsSel::Five {
                    // CSTOPB + CS5 == 1.5 stop bits on Linux.
                    StopBits::Two
                } else {
                    note = Some(if cfg!(target_os = "linux") {
                        crate::i18n::tr("本系统 (Linux) 仅在数据位为 5 时支持 1.5 位停止位，已按 2 位停止位处理")
                            .to_owned()
                    } else {
                        crate::i18n::tr("当前平台/驱动不支持 1.5 位停止位，已按 2 位停止位处理")
                            .to_owned()
                    });
                    StopBits::Two
                }
            }
        };

    pub newline_lf: bool,

    pub timed: bool,
    /// 定时发送周期 (ms).

}

impl Default for SendSettings {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            hex: false,
            append_newline: true,
            newline_cr: true,
            newline_lf: true,
            timed: false,
            period_ms: 1000,
            history: Vec::new(),
            buffer: String::new(),
        }
    }
}

impl SendSettings {
    /// Cap on remembered payloads.
    pub const MAX_HISTORY: usize = 32;

    /// The newline suffix implied by the flags.
    pub fn newline_bytes(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(2);
        if self.newline_cr {
            out.push(b'\r');
        }
        if self.newline_lf {
            out.push(b'\n');
        }
        out
    }

    /// Remember a payload, de-duplicating and bounding the list.
    pub fn remember(&mut self, payload: &str) {
        if payload.trim().is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        self.history.retain(|h| h != payload);
        self.history.insert(0, payload.to_owned());
        self.history.truncate(Self::MAX_HISTORY);
    }
}

/// The complete persisted state.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(default)]
pub struct Settings {
    pub theme: ThemeMode,
    /// Interface language; `None` means "not chosen yet, follow the system".
    pub lang: Option<Lang>,

    /// Receive decoding: `None` means auto-detect.
    pub encoding: EncodingChoice,
    /// Transmit encoding: `None` means "follow the receive encoding".
    pub tx_encoding: EncodingChoice,
    pub send: SendSettings,
    pub multi: MultiSend,
    pub protocol: ProtocolConfig,
    /// Persistent font selections and sizes.
    pub fonts: FontSettings,
    /// The protocol panel's data field, restored on startup.

    pub log_font_size: f32,

    #[test]
    fn serial_port_combo_and_refresh_share_row_in_both_languages() {
        let _guard = crate::i18n::test_lock();
        for language in [crate::i18n::Lang::ZhCn, crate::i18n::Lang::EnUs] {
            crate::i18n::set_lang(language);
            let ctx = egui::Context::default();
            let mut app = seeded();
            for _ in 0..2 {
                full_frame(&ctx, &mut app, input());
            }

            let combo = panels::probe::port_combo_rect();
            let data_bits = panels::probe::data_bits_combo_rect();
            let refresh = panels::probe::refresh_button_rect();
            assert!(combo.width() > 0.0, "{language:?}: port combo missing");
            assert!(
                data_bits.width() > 0.0,
                "{language:?}: data-bits combo missing"
            );
            assert!(refresh.width() > 0.0, "{language:?}: refresh missing");
            assert!(
                (combo.width() - data_bits.width()).abs() <= 0.25,

                (combo.center().y - refresh.center().y).abs() <= 0.5,

            );
            assert!(
                combo.max.x <= refresh.min.x,
                "{language:?}: port combo overlaps refresh: {combo:?} vs {refresh:?}"
            );
        }
        crate::i18n::set_lang(crate::i18n::Lang::ZhCn);
    }

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn summary_format() {
        let cfg = SerialConfig::default();
        assert_eq!(cfg.summary(), "115200-8N1");

        let cfg = SerialConfig {
            baud: 9600,
            data_bits: DataBitsSel::Seven,
            parity: ParitySel::Even,
            stop_bits: StopBitsSel::Two,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert_eq!(cfg.summary(), "9600-7E2");
    }

    #[test]
    fn default_plan_matches_selection() {
        let cfg = SerialConfig::default();
        let plan = cfg.to_plan();
        assert_eq!(plan.baud, 115200);
        assert_eq!(plan.data_bits, DataBits::Eight);
        assert_eq!(plan.stop_bits, StopBits::One);
        assert_eq!(plan.parity, Parity::None);
        assert_eq!(plan.flow, FlowControl::None);
        assert!(plan.note.is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn one_point_five_is_never_silently_wrong() {
        let cfg = SerialConfig {
            stop_bits: StopBitsSel::OnePointFive,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let plan = cfg.to_plan();
        // Either it is genuinely representable, or the user is told.
        if plan.note.is_none() {
            assert!(cfg!(target_os = "linux") && cfg.data_bits == DataBitsSel::Five);
        }
    }
}

impl SerialConfig {
    /// Remember a valid, non-standard baud rate for future runs.
    pub fn remember_custom_baud(&mut self, baud: u32) {
        self.normalize_custom_bauds();
        if !(CUSTOM_BAUD_RANGE.0..=CUSTOM_BAUD_RANGE.1).contains(&baud)
            || STANDARD_BAUDS.contains(&baud)
        {
            return;
        }
        self.custom_bauds.retain(|candidate| *candidate != baud);
        self.custom_bauds.push(baud);
        self.custom_bauds.sort_unstable();
        self.custom_bauds.truncate(MAX_CUSTOM_BAUDS);
    }

    /// Standard and remembered choices, sorted without duplicates.
    pub fn baud_choices(&self) -> Vec<u32> {
        let mut choices: std::collections::BTreeSet<u32> = STANDARD_BAUDS.into_iter().collect();
        choices.extend(
            self.custom_bauds
                .iter()
                .copied()
                .filter(|baud| (CUSTOM_BAUD_RANGE.0..=CUSTOM_BAUD_RANGE.1).contains(baud)),
        );
        choices.into_iter().collect()
    }

    fn normalize_custom_bauds(&mut self) {
        self.custom_bauds.retain(|baud| {
            (CUSTOM_BAUD_RANGE.0..=CUSTOM_BAUD_RANGE.1).contains(baud)
                && !STANDARD_BAUDS.contains(baud)
        });
        self.custom_bauds.sort_unstable();
        self.custom_bauds.dedup();
        self.custom_bauds.truncate(MAX_CUSTOM_BAUDS);
    }

fn serial_section(app: &mut XcomApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
    let open = app.link.is_open();
    let serial_bounds = ui.max_rect();
    probe::set_serial_content_rect(serial_bounds);
    probe::begin_serial_combos();
    egui::CollapsingHeader::new(tr("串口设置"))
        .default_open(true)
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            egui::Grid::new("serial_grid")
                .num_columns(2)
                .spacing([8.0, 6.0])
                .show(ui, |ui| {
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        ui.label(tr("串口"));
                        let refresh = ui.add_enabled(!open, egui::Button::new(tr("刷新")));
                        probe::set_refresh_button_rect(refresh.rect);
                        if refresh.clicked() {
                            app.ports.poll();
                            app.info(tr("已刷新串口列表"));
                        }
                    });
                    {
                        let ports = app.ports.ports().to_vec();
                        let current = app.settings.serial.port.clone();
                        let selected_text = ports
                            .iter()
                            .find(|p| p.name == current)
                            .map(|p| p.display())
                            .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                                if current.is_empty() {
                                    tr("（无可用串口）").to_owned()
                                } else {
                                    current.clone()
                                }
                            });
                        let port_combo_width = SERIAL_COMBO_WIDTH;
                        ui.add_enabled_ui(!open, |ui| {
                            ui.set_max_width(port_combo_width);
                            let port_combo = egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("port_select")
                                .selected_text(selected_text)
                                .width(port_combo_width)
                                .truncate()
                                .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                                    if ports.is_empty() {
                                        ui.weak(tr("未检测到串口"));
                                    }
                                    for port in &ports {
                                        let item = ui.selectable_label(
                                            port.name == app.settings.serial.port,
                                            port.display(),
                                        );
                                        let item = item.on_hover_text(
                                            port.detail().unwrap_or_else(|| port.display()),
                                        );
                                        if item.clicked() {
                                            app.settings.serial.port = port.name.clone();
                                            app.mark_settings_dirty();
                                        }

 impl SerialConfig {
+    /// Remember a valid, non-standard baud rate for future runs.
+    pub fn remember_custom_baud(&mut self, baud: u32) {
+        self.normalize_custom_bauds();
+        if !(CUSTOM_BAUD_RANGE.0..=CUSTOM_BAUD_RANGE.1).contains(&baud)
+            || STANDARD_BAUDS.contains(&baud)
+        {
+            return;
+        }
+        self.custom_bauds.retain(|candidate| *candidate != baud);
+        self.custom_bauds.push(baud);
+        self.custom_bauds.sort_unstable();
+        self.custom_bauds.truncate(MAX_CUSTOM_BAUDS);
+    }
+
+    /// Standard and remembered choices, sorted without duplicates.
+    pub fn baud_choices(&self) -> Vec<u32> {
+        let mut choices: std::collections::BTreeSet<u32> = STANDARD_BAUDS.into_iter().collect();
+        choices.extend(
+            self.custom_bauds
+                .iter()
+                .copied()
+                .filter(|baud| (CUSTOM_BAUD_RANGE.0..=CUSTOM_BAUD_RANGE.1).contains(baud)),
+        );
+        choices.into_iter().collect()
+    }
+
+    fn normalize_custom_bauds(&mut self) {
+        self.custom_bauds.retain(|baud| {
+            (CUSTOM_BAUD_RANGE.0..=CUSTOM_BAUD_RANGE.1).contains(baud)
+                && !STANDARD_BAUDS.contains(baud)
+        });
+        self.custom_bauds.sort_unstable();
+        self.custom_bauds.dedup();
+        self.custom_bauds.truncate(MAX_CUSTOM_BAUDS);
+    }

    #[test]
    fn dragging_the_send_separator_grows_the_editor() {
        let ctx = egui::Context::default();
        let mut app = XcomApp::headless(crate::settings::Settings::default());

        full_frame(&ctx, &mut app, input());
        let before = panels::probe::editor_rect();
        let panel = panels::probe::send_panel_rect();
        assert!(before.height() > 0.0, "the editor was not laid out");
        assert!(panel.height() > 0.0, "the send panel was not laid out");

        let grab = egui::pos2(panel.center().x, panel.top());
        drag(&ctx, &mut app, grab, egui::pos2(grab.x, grab.y - 90.0));

        let after = panels::probe::editor_rect();
        assert!(
            after.height() > before.height() + 40.0,
            "the editor did not follow the separator: {} -> {}",
            before.height(),
            after.height()
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn shrinking_the_settings_panel_persists() {
        // Reported: dragging the left separator *left* clipped the panel's
        // content during the gesture and then snapped back on release, while
        // the receive area never grew.
        let ctx = egui::Context::default();
        let mut app = XcomApp::headless(crate::settings::Settings::default());
        app.show_side_panel = false;

        let before = full_frame(&ctx, &mut app, input());
        let grab = egui::pos2(before.min.x, before.center().y);
        drag(&ctx, &mut app, grab, egui::pos2(grab.x - 40.0, grab.y));

        let after = full_frame(&ctx, &mut app, input());
        assert!(
            after.min.x < before.min.x - 20.0,
            "the panel snapped back instead of staying shrunk: {} -> {}",
            before.min.x,
            after.min.x
        );

        // And it must still be shrunk several frames later, i.e. the size was
        // committed rather than merely applied for one frame.
        for _ in 0..5 {
            full_frame(&ctx, &mut app, input());
        }
        assert!(
            full_frame(&ctx, &mut app, input()).min.x < before.min.x - 20.0,
            "the shrunk size was not persisted"
        );
    }
